title: Glossier Dupe?
text: I bought this product because I heard it was a dupe for the Glossier Lidstars. I will say that it is close, but not quite. Like the Lidstars, it does sheer out nicely. It also does last most of the day. Today I wore it without primer. I saw some creasing in the lids but nothing major. I expect it will do even better with the primer. Compared to the Lidstars, I think this product is more buildable if you want a glittery look. It is also significantly cheaper. However, the one downside is that the actual liquid that the glitter sits in is very transparent. I would have to try another color to see if it is just the gold formula, but I think I prefer how the Lidstars has a wash of color along with the glitter.

title: Smaller Than I Thought But Still Beautiful Head Pieces🥰
text:
Hi, It’s Glamorous Gem, hope you all are having a wonderful day,

Anyway, I always like a universal accessory that goes with just about anything chic and simple. This would definitely complete any outfit with those attributes.

I love the design. The silky texture is super cute and attractive, and the pearls really make these headbands pop. So elegant, smooth, and stylish.

These are also quite thick. There is silky fabric on the outside and thicker fabric on the inside surrounded by a metal band. There’s a single band on one side and three metal bars on the other lined with fabrics and pearls as well.

This doesn’t look or feel too cheap. They are above hair store quality and seem very sturdy. They fit on my medium sized head quite easily and with no slip. They also don’t seem super uncomfortable when wearing as well.

The only problem I had with these are that they are a bit smaller than I expected. I thought they would be wider to cover flyaways, but these are a bit slimmer than expected. But, they do seem cool and unique. And, these are perfect for those that like to show their edges with a fresh new hairstyle like me.

So, all in all, these fit my recommendation for switching it up in spring. It’s always good to try something new.

PS: No matter the nature, I only write honest, unbiased, and authentic reviews. Thanks for reading🥰🥰🥰

title: Moisturizing ingredients
text:
Kopari, you have done it again.
Fabulous little set of Lip Glosses, super moisturizing and contain Coconut Oil, Shea Butter and Squalane for those dry peely cracked lips.

They go on nice and smooth, just gently squeeze the tube, and a little bit comes out, but don’t press too hard. They look great over a Matte Finish Lippy, or just on their own, of the three flavours (grape, bubblegum, and strawberry) my fave is the strawberry, which has a reddish pink tint, but isn’t strongly coloured, and goes on sheer. It wouldn’t affect the colour of any lippy you were wearing underneath.

They aren’t sticky, and i no longer have long hair that clings to such products, so i can wear them without that happening anymore.

I like this set a lot, it’s a beautiful presentation, as are all Kopari products I’ve had, and could easily be gifted to any Lip Gloss lovers out there, of any age, in my humble opinion.

title: Don't let even a drop get in your eyes
text:
This may help with dandruff if you use it a number of times. I have used it the last four or five shampoos and the dandruff is only slightly less.

But I am not going to use it again. The first time some got in my eyes. They burned, they stung. I washed it out in the shower, repeatedly flushing my eyes. The burning continued for a number of hours. Then I was extremely careful in subsequent uses but today even though I was careful I got a drop in the eye. I flushed and flushed. It is not burning but to heck with this.

I called the optometrist's office after the burning. Received a call back from the office in which I was told that is was possibly the menthol or the amount of menthol in the product. I'd like confirmation of what causes such extreme irritation so I can buy another brand without the offending ingredient.

title: This Stuff is AMAZING!
text:
I’ve been dealing with a skin rash for a little over a month. I had tried bag balm (which would typically work for rashes) to no avail and stumbled across some information on social media about colloidal silver. I was intrigued and figured I’d try it. Before purchasing this I had heard about “nano-Silver” and how it was supposed to be more effective than colloidal silver because it was eon charged (or something like that) so I went with some of that, in liquid form. I was ingesting it and spraying it on my skin. It did absolutely nothing. As a matter of fact, it dried the rash out and made it look more pronounce than it already had.

Then I searched to see if they had a moisturizer with silver in it. I was determined for this stuff to work. That’s when I saw the Silver Miracles soap and cream. I bought both. I received the soap first and began using it. I noticed a difference in a little under a week. Then the cream came. No joke, after TWO days of using it (morning and night), the rash was GONE. Completely.

I recomm nd this stuff to anyone. If you’re thinking about it but you aren’t sure, just go for it. I’m not gaining anything by writing this review so I have no reason to lie. I’m only writing it because I’m excited about it. I’ve had that rash for over a month and it’s completely gone after using this for two days. Silver Miracles Colloidal Silver is awesome and I will be using it exclusively from this point forward.

On a side note, don’t bother with “nano” silver, especially the liquid. Not for external use at least. It did nothing.

title: Not just cotton and silk - contains polyester
text:
I won't say the product is necessarily bad, but I certainly do not like it and am not pleased with the disparity between the description and the actual product.

While the amazon page says these eye-covers are made of cotton and silk, the product packaging and tags both indicate the product is cotton, silk, AND polyester. I would not have bought these had I known this as my wife reacts to polyester. This just leaves me with another useless set of eye covers that my wife can't use.

Also, I personally find these uncomfortable. The silk is nothing like my nice soft silk shirts. It is still a shiny and smooth fabric, yet also an uncomfortably rough (I'm not sure how better to describe it -- it's like running your skin over tiny closely spaced wires), fabric that is very hot to wear on your face. Furthermore, I found that I got a headache both times I tried wearing these.

My wife has previously made some passable eye-covers out of cotton socks that we both can wear -- and I find significantly more comfortable. She's suggested that maybe she can try taking these apart and using the straps and cotton parts and making better cotton-sock eye-covers. I'm skeptical and am considering returning these. I'm certainly not happy.

If you like the really slick-abrasive feeling fabrics like cheap silks or cheap satins, and if you don't have any issue with the polyester in these, I can't really see a problem with them. They could probably benefit from being a bit larger, but they're 'pillowy'-enough (for lack of a better word) to block out most of the light and fill in the gaps around the edges. Mystery as to why they give me a headache, but they've enough good reviews that it can't be common.

I'm giving them 2 stars because I think the description is misleading and I don't like them, but also because I think a more moderate rating would get this lost among rating of people who are happy with the item. I always read some of the reviews and I wish I'd seen a review like this before purchasing.

title: Works well, easy to use, one drawback is tricky to take apart and put back together for cleaning
text:
We purchased Pet Electric Hair Clipper: professional tools for your love pets/grooming clipper, from Caleegi.

Everything appears to be quite well made, of sturdy construction. The scissors and nail trimmers came out of the box sharp, and have a good weight to them. The nail trimmers have a good locking mechanism, metal, not plastic; I think it will last. The set comes with a convenient little storage pouch, which I hadn't noticed on the item description specs list. I like the colors of the pouch. They're cute. The pouch easily fits everything in the kit, except the brush. You can make the brush fit, but I dont think you can make the brush and electric clippers fit. I couldn't. The electric clippers come with a usb powered charger cord, but not a charger block. This is not a standard charger. If you lose this charge cord, you may be hard pressed to find a replacement.

The brush is of good construction, and the ergonomic handle grip is a joy to hold. For real, it just feels good in your hand. I like the push button hair dislodger for easy brush cleaning. Our dog is fairly short haired, straight and wirey, and our cat is fluffy but on the short side of medium length hair. It took very little hair off them, and I haven't found a product better than the Furminator for brushing them. But I've had and worked with longer haired dogs, and for a Great Pyrenees, Burnese Mountain Dog, or Saint Bernard, I think this would be the perfect brush.

The nail file worked great. The comb I intend to keep for myself- it's perfect for my wiry, sometimes wavy, sometimes curly, always disobedient hair.

The electric clipper charged fairly quickly, enough that I could take it for a test spin about 15-20 minutes after plugging it in. I love the electronic digital display, showing how far along in its charging it is, and the RPMs of the clipper blades. I love that it came with a little bottle of lubricant solution for the blades (none of my personal trimmers ever have). The little obligatory cleaning brush to sweep between the blades looks much the same that any electric trimmer does, but I found it shed a wire or two with every pass throughthe blades, which my personal trimmer brushes do not.

I tried the electric clippers out on myself first. I was a little bummed that the nearly universal gaurds that come with clippers designed for people did not fit. The clippers are much more quiet then most clippers, which is good for not startling pets. I used the clippers with the guard on the sides of my head and with no gaurd to shave my face. It went easily through my hair, had no trouble, and gave me a close, even shave. And I went a little rough to see if there was any danger of maybe cutting a squirming or struggling pet, and it seems very safe.

The clipper blades came off pretty easy for cleaning, but were kind of tricky to put back on, and in trying to do so, I hit at a funny angle and the entire clipper assembly fell apart in to 4 pieces. That was annoying, but after messing around with it for about a half hour, I was able to put it back together, and it still worked fine. I would be hesitant to take it apart for cleaning again, though I'm sure I will. Despite this one design flaw, I still think overall this is a pretty quality product.

title: Either You Love it... or you hate it....
text:
I can see why this shampoo gets either 5 stars or 1 star from its reviewers — and almost nothing in between.

PROS: I like it because it contains only healthy ingredients with no SLS or other detergents nor any added fragrances — a blend with these features is such a rare thing, not easy to find. Also, it's very mild, with no stripping action, and leaves my hair soft + easy to comb even without conditioner. It's also one of the few shampoos that does not make my scalp itch. So, it's become my product of choice!

CONS: Often (depending on how dirty the hair is) it doesn't suds on the first application... which is not what we're used to and can be frustrating... so, you could end up pouring on way too much of it toward that end. But just be patient: Don't add more, just rinse and do a second application, if needed... it will suds nicely.

I first used this shampoo years ago and was glad to rediscover it a year or so ago via Amazon. I am definitely a fan.

title: So far, nothing to write home about.
text:
I am a self imposed victim of over plucking my brows, and of my lashes seeming to become shorter and more sparse as I'm aging.

I've been wanting to try some of the many lash growth serums for a long time. The first thing I tried was Castor Oil. It seemed to help my lashes grow, and look a bit thicker. I then got this LashRevive serum, and another serum at the same time. I used LashRevive on my right lashes and brow, and the other brand on the left lashes and brow. I will only be discussing results for the right eye, with the LashRevive serum in this review.

I noticed a lot of wonderful reviews for this product, lots of pictures of the bottle, but no before and after pictures.
I received my product on the 11th of June, and today is June 25th, so I have been using this product consistently for 2 weeks.

First for the lashes. I am including a picture of before and after so you can judge for yourselves. The left side is before, right side is after. I really see little difference. When I look in the mirror, I feel as though they are more noticeable, maybe a tiny bit thicker, or darker, but not by much. But as you can see, the picture reflects none of that. Maybe it's just wishful thinking. I can say that on my lower lashes, mostly toward the inner corner, I have seen growth. They are much longer. It's weird that they are only on the inside though. I do not have before/after pictures of that, as I was not expecting this to effect the lower lashes.

On to the brows. I can see a difference in my brow. It appears fuller to me. I'm a natural blonde, so the newest hairs that are growing in are very light, almost white blonde, and difficult to see in the included picture, but I do believe you can see a tiny bit of a difference. Nothing dramatic. It's enough for me to continue to use it for my brows. Again, before picture on the left, after on the right. Judge for yourselves.

Application was super easy. It's a thick, milky consistency, and has a nice large applicator brush to easily cover the lashes and brow area quickly. I experienced no irritation to the skin, or to the eye. Never felt any sort of sting or burn at all. I did have gunk in the corners of my eye in the morning, and weird white stringy stuff in my lashes. Easy enough to remove when I washed my face in the morning. I did notice what seemed like more lashes than normal actually fall out, in the beginning. Maybe it was only because I was paying more attention to my lashes though. It was about 2-3 per day. Obviously not enough to be noticeable as you can see in the before/after pic.

I'm confused with this product. I did not see enough results to give this 4 or 5 stars. But saw enough of a result on the brow to think (hope) that I may get better results with continued use, so I did not give it just 1 star. I am going to continue to use this product until I run out, and I will update this review with any positive/negative results.

I received this product for free in exchange for my review. I hope this was helpful for you.

title: Sturdy, cute, works well
text:
I’m a licensed (cosmo) lash tech and thought this would be a nice combo. I received it in a day (thank you prime) and waited until I used it to write a review.
So! The tweezers; love. I love the color, and I feel like they’re nice and sharp. They fit comfortable in my hands & I had no problem isolating the lashes and picking up fans or even single ones. I did accidentally drop the straight ones (I know) & the top barely bent, still useable. I would definitely buy them again especially 2 for 1. Also I let them soak in barbercide to clean for about 10-15mins after every use, no discoloring or rusting so far!

The jade stones; they’re bigger than I thought, which I love. It has a nice cool temperature & I change the glue out about ever 30 mins or so. I do put tape down on the jade stone so I don’t ruin it.. I got glue on the stone itself and it didn’t come off which is why I recommend tape.

Over all I would definitely recommend giving it a try!

title: You get what you pay for
text:
While a good value set if you don't want to spend too much on nail polish, want to give it away as a gift or buy it as a starter set, the quality of the polishes aren't that great. The pastel and neon colours are very sheer, even with 2 coats. You will need to apply a white polish underneath them in order to make them more opaque. The glitter colours are so-so. The metallic colours are the best in my opinion - the shades available are good and are nice and opaque. The biggest gripe I have about this set is that they all chip less than 24 hours after I do my nails. In comparison, the Essie nail polishes last a week before they even start to chip.

TLDR: you get what you pay for.

title: Almost perfect
text:
I purchased an sleep mask just like this in a store and, when it went missing, searched for it high and low until I found it here on Amazon. The mask blocks light well with little or no light leaking in around your nose and none around the eyes. The contoured eye coverings place no pressure on your eyelids. I never felt comfortable sleeping in a traditional sleep mask until I used this style. I can even open my eyes in my mask and my lashes don't even brush it.

The comfort in wearing meant I quickly adjusted to its use and now can't hardly sleep without it. As someone who has had trouble sleeping and finds napping almost impossible, having the routine of perfect dark when I sleep at night has allowed me to build a trigger. Now, when I need to sleep early, want to catch a nap, find myself in a plane, or other times I might ordinarily find it hard to sleep, I can place my mask on and it signals sleep perfectly. It's improved my sleep length and frequency, as well as reduced the time it takes me to fall asleep, which I think anyone could appreciate.

My only gripe is that, while I thought this one was exactly like my previous mask, there's a little difference. There's a little plastic piece on the side of the elastic that joins loops for the adjustment system and they sit very near my ears. I can sometimes feel it digging in and I never remember feeling that on my previous mask. For occasional use, you may not notice it, but using them nightly, the little part can bother me sometimes. My solution plan involves breaking the part and replacing it with something soft or hand-sewing that connection point. Customization is a very small price to pay for the amazingly comfortable contoured foam that makes up the main body of the mask.

title: gentle cleansing, lots of suds, leaves skin clean but not parched, great for travel
text:
Individually wrapped cleansing cloths that are way better than any other I have used in the past. The material has a good strong feel, and it is large enough that it nearly feels like a washcloth. I can really get my hand on it. The packets easily tear open. The cloth, once wet becomes crazy sudsy. It has a barely there scent. I really have to sniff to be able to detect anything. Very fresh. The lather is gentle and non drying. I was surprised that my face was not feeling parched or taut afterward.

Not only for face, but it makes for a decent cleansing cloth to have a "bird bath" at the sink. Just wipe down everywhere you need to, rinse the cloth, rinse your body, rinse the cloth again, ring it out, use it to pat down the body.. and away you go.

I think one could get away with using half a cloth easily for just face washing as there is plenty of cleaning agent in it.

Overall it is a lovely product. I think it is perfectly packaged for occasional use, or for on the go/ travel. If I were to use it all the time, I would prefer something with less packaging. Maybe they have that... I didn't look.

But for travel: definite yes. I would go so far as to use one in the shower to take care of face and entire body. The cleanser is so gentle, which is a huge draw for me and my dry/rosacea skin.

title: I don't really have time to write too many reviews of products I've bought so I only write reviews for products that are either
text: I bought this product probably about a month ago. I don't really have time to write too many reviews of products I've bought so I only write reviews for products that are either really great or really bad usually. I saw this product WORK! Right before my eyes. I am in my mid 30's and have always had freckly skin and the sun makes them get bigger and run together but I've now started to get age spots. They appear out of nowhere and they're big and darker than my freckles.Coincidentally, after receiving this product and using it for a few days, I woke up one morning with a big, brown AGE SPOT right under my eye. I was really upset about it as it was very noticeable. I was using Wonderpiel for a few days morning and night already when the spot appeared, so I continued using it, making sure to apply to the spot as well. I wore concealer to hide this thing and it was noticeable again by the end of each day when the concealer wore off. But one morning (9 days after the spot's arrival) I woke up and didn't see the spot. So I washed my face again, thinking I must have left the concealer on overnight, but it was GONE! I know I'm being dramatic, but I really am having trouble aging gracefully and am very self-conscious. Wonderpiel really made me happy, and is one of the few products I've used that has basically worked magic for me. Now, I do still have freckles and "discolorations" and uneven skin tone, but I've had that all my life so I don't expect this product to work as fast as it did on my brand-new age spot. I THINK I see them fading a bit but want to keep using until I'm sure of it. But, for all who are wondering whether or not to buy this product, do it. I saw it work, and will be buying another bottle.

I think this kit will last me a LONG time

text: Highly pigmented, romantic/grungy/steampunk shades abound! This purchase was sort of a shot in the dark for me. I've never heard of this brand specifically, but knew the color family I was looking for and this one is perfect. Most of these "generic" palettes, including Morphe, is made in China and this palette is no exception. However, the shadows are rich, pigmented, and last a really long time on the eyes. I love the warm, rusty shades, but there is also lighter pinks, champagnes, and beige frosty shades to mix things up. It is an ALL Shimmer palette, so you will need some mattes from an additional palette for a complete look. This is perfect for my fall/winter makeup rotation.

title: Concept needs Tweaking.
text: I love the product and concept of quick, easy and straight.  But I am really fed up trying to turn it on!!  It worked after trying to figure out how to turn it on the first time(directions are super small print and hard to find), but trying to turn it on again has been further frustrating!  I recommend a simple KNOB power button!  Also, it may help keep it on without accidentally pressing it off, another concept failure in my opinion.  The placing is wrong.  Why put controls where your hands and fingers rest trying to use the brush?  The part I loved is that it actually works as a straightener.  I have thick hair and it usually takes me an hour to get my hair straightened with an iron.  This was a simple 15 minutes!  So while I love that part, it doesn't work if you can't get the damn thing on in the first place.  Fix that, the placement of controls, and I would be 100% sold on the product.

title: Loved this product. (Yes, it's just a stippling brush, but better than DIY.)
text:
I can't rave enough about this product. I've had it for a couple months now, and I've used it with mostly eyeshadow, but all sorts of colors. It's removed them all pretty much instantly! I will say that the only problem with this is that it will probably make people forget that even though it's taking off the pigment, it's not removing bacteria and such, so you should probably still wash your brushes once or twice a month.

And yes. I know that it's just a stippling brush in a little can. So if you want to DIY it, I'm sure you could. I find this a lot more convenient than trying to spend an afternoon coming up with a copy of this. Part of its use is the can: the stippling part doesn't move around (well, it rotates a little) because it's contained in the can. So I just have it sitting in a corner of my makeup box, and I can just brush my brushes towards the inside corner, and it doesn't move. Alternatively, you could put some hot glue or silicone on the top face of the lid, so when you put the lid on the bottom (like the picture) and had it on your countertop, it wouldn't slide, either.

Anyways, love this product! Also works with bigger brushes. I'm wishing I'd bought the duo, though, because it's supposed to work with creme make up.

title: I’m never going to buy a different brand of mascara.
text:
This product is AMAZING. It never clumps so shortens “getting ready” time significantly. The gliding smoothness takes a bit getting used to. That typical mascara thickness just isn’t there. But it didn’t take me long to get the hang of it and love it. My lashes now have a natural, full, thick look to them. One or two coats is all it takes.

It’s waterproof in a gentle way. Never melts down, but is super easy to remove with my Trader Joe’s organic coconut oil. I even use it on my eyebrows, brush and all. Works great. Same ease of waterproof application.

I had already gotten great lash growth thickness with the NuSkin product, but it has only gotten better with this mascara. I’m so happy I switched from my old waterproof Maybelline fixation. I’m 67 and had previously been considering extensions. Now I can even go out without any makeup and feel good about the way I look. I’m living proof that the high quality organic ingredients are a better fit for our bodies.

It lasts a long time too and doesn’t dry out in the container. I’m starting month four on my first tube and it’s still not empty or drying out.

It feels great to finally find a company offering high quality, organic make up at affordable prices. Gonna see if they have a concealer next for those occasionally dark eyelid areas closest to the nose. I’ll do a review on it too.

title: I don't know a ton about razors but I do know when the man is happy with his
text:
I got this shaver as a gift for my husband who normally uses those shavers where you keep the handles but have to constantly buy the disposable heads. I've always seen pictures of these types of razors in shaving commercials so I figured I would give him a little gift. And WOW! I really didn't expect it to go over as well as it did! I don't know a ton about razors but I do know when the man is happy with his.

As soon as I got it and gave it to him, he was a little reluctant to change his routine. But then I couldn't get it back from him even to do a review for it! He loves it! He says it gives him a much closer shave (probably due to the fact that there's an actual razor blade inside the shaver) and that, while it's a little weird shaving with just the edge of a razor (instead of having those disposable heads against his cheek) he's starting to prefer it because of the results he's getting.

And it's really easy to clean! You simply turn a knob in the handle and the shaver opens and you can take out the blade inside and give it a little rinse and you're done! My husband applies a little oil to make it go further but it's a less than 30 second job and he sets it to dry to be ready for the next use.

After his experience, I really recommend this shaver to anyone else in the market who may have the same experience as him! My husband is a very hard man to impress and the fact that this has immediately become his new favorite razor says a lot to me and I hope it does to you as well.

If you add the small hose attachment, then its suction power lessens even further. It was doing a halfway decent job at cleaning my keyboard, but the attachment kept falling off. The Aoraem requires you to turn the entire top half of the unit to power it. That’s fine for turning it on, but when you try to turn it off, it can loosen the bottom tray and the particles spill out if you’re not careful. It is easier to replace the batteries on this model versus my other one, but that’s the only thing I like about it.

title: Poor design.
text: I am a lifelong user of Norelco electric razors (20+ years). I have 3 of them all working. I've had this one for close to 3 years and almost never use it. It shaves poorly, because it cannot be cleaned properly. On the older models you can remove and clean the individual blades. After a week of use, on the older models you can see they need thorough cleaning as residue accumulates at the cutting  edge. This can only be done with a brush, AFTER you remove the blade. The Arcitec doesn't allow you to do this. No amount of rinsing in the water will clean the Arcitec heads. Those who say "cleans easily" don't realize that rinsing the cutting head only cleans it superficially. Also as others noted the razor will not hold the whiskers when shaving and will make a mess. The chambers for clippings storage are ridiculously small and you need to empty them after each use. No matter how many passes you take, it will miss some hairs.

title: Follow The Directions to The Letter for Bare Balls! EDIT: Chemical BURN!
text:
I read a lot of positive and negative reviews on the product before trying it which made apprehensive. After following the directions to the letter, and I mean using the 'nutshell' method, using the sticks, applying as directed, waiting only 10 mins. exactly using a stop watch, then immediately rinsing and using the supplied glove, I can report that my junk is smooth and bare. Again, as it says in the directions, do Not use any soap or anything else 'down there' except the calm balm, which you should use the moment you get out of the shower and dry off. The only 'off label' thing I did was to use a pair of vinyl gloves to hold the stick and my junk so that I didn't get the cream all over my hands. Last, I read earlier reviews which stated this stuff had a smell. There is a little odor, but it was mild and dare I say pleasant, especially compared with any depilatory cream I've ever smelled before. This is especially important to me, because I share a bathroom, so it's nice to keep my business MY business, and not have others knowing what you've 'just done' in the bathroom.
EDIT: Chemical Burn! Despite my glowing previous review, I now say Stay the Hell Away From This Stuff! I had used this product 2 times when I wrote the above review. I used it a third time over a week later, still followed the directions, and got a serious 2nd Degree Burn on my nuts! The pain is indescribable, but let's just say it's like being hit in the balls with a baseball bat while they're roasting in a fire!!! I will NEVER, EVER put anything like this on my balls again. Kinda sucks to have 'smooth balls', but have them drenched in antibiotic ointment and pain cream, then wrapped in a mile of sterile gauze. Doctor's Expenses? Embarrassment? Excruciating Pain? Yes, you too can 'have it all' with Balls Balm..!

title: Great for making buns, and helps curl your hair too!
text:
I had one of these when I was a kid, and I LOVED it, but at some point I got rid of it, and I really wish I hadn't. This "Hairigami" or whatever you want to call it is AWESOME. I have long hair that doesn't hold a curl well, but after I put my hair up in this for several hours, my hair comes out almost perfectly curled in a really natural-looking way. It does take some practice to get it right every time, but once you know how to do it, it's super quick and easy. I took some pictures to show my friends the steps, so I figured I'd include them here too (sorry for the quality--taking pictures of the back of your head isn't easy!).

STEP 1: Place your hair between the two arms (I don't know if that's the technical term, but that's what we'll call it here). I took these pics after I'd already had my hair up in this thing for a couple hours, so that's why my hair is already curly (my hair is very straight and thick)

STEP 2: Drag the Hairigami down a little over halfway down your hair (I tried to roll it up from the bottom of my hair the first time, and since my hair is slightly layered that was impossible to do. Also my arms aren't long enough to do that comfortably). Then, roll up until the Hairigami is snug against your head. (Note -- roll UP, do not roll under, it doesn't work if you roll under, or at least it didn't for me)

STEP 3: Snap the Hairigami (which is basically just 2 cloth-covered snap bracelets) so that it curls into a bun. This is a great hairstyle for work, or anything really, so if you want to just leave your hair in this bun, you may need to gently spread your hair out so that the entire Hairigami is evenly covered. **NOTE: As a former dancer, I would exercise caution when using this for dancing. While it may feel very secure, the bun WILL NOT hold up well if you're doing lots of turns. It may work great for younger dancers who are not doing so many turns, but even then that's iffy. If using it for dance class, TEST IT FIRST to make sure your bun isn't going to unravel in the middle of class!**

STEP 4: After a few hours (that depends on your hair -- I only waited about 3 hours and my hair came out super nice and curly, but everyone's hair is going to be different), unroll the Hairigami and see how nice and curly your hair is!

Bottom line: this thing is great for making buns, and great to help curl your hair too. It seems like a weird invention, but it's actually great!

title: Definitely better than old-school sunless tanners
text:
MY Positives: No streaks or unsightly orange-y spots, noticeable color after 1 use, smell (like peach tea) is less-bad than old-school tanners, and I only need to use it every 2-4 days to maintain color (can't imagine daily use).

MY Negatives: Smell is there and stays and stays (and stays on clothes), damp and heavy feel on skin (like never soaks in - I prefer lighter, barely-there moisturizer), at end of day I can wipe yellow-orange off skin with a damp washcloth.

I'll stick with this until the next-gen of sunless tanners comes out. I guess doing away with the smell is hard for manufacturers - after 8 hours I really get tired of smelling it!

he people at Jaylie offered me this product for free in exchange of my honest review.

Right now I am in damage control mode for my belly and preventing the appearance of more in other places.

What I like about this lotion is the texture, some lotions are extremely greasy, this one is perfect, absorbs fast you can dress right away.

Smell like citrus (another plus) and leaves your skin sultry.

My skin feels smoother, hydrated, healthier.

The color of the stretch marks do fade, do they disappear? No they don't, but they definitely look better.

I like the product, it is way better than your regular lotion and I would buy it again for the full price.

title: Excellent!
text: I read most of the reviews posted here and it really seems that you are not going to know whether or not the shaver you choose is going to do the job until you buy it and try it. I had tried a number of the Braun style shavers and they just ripped me up, yet others will swear that they are the best you can buy. I have gone back and forth between the razor and my old triple-head Norelco and decided it was time to get a new one. First off, this is a good looking shaver. Feels good, if a little light, in the hand, too. I have waited the recommended 21 days before writing this review and I am very pleased with this product. I have a better than average beard and I more often then not skip a few days on the weekends. The 1050 handles it all, smooth and clean. I rinse it everytime - it's so easy - just flip up the blade covers and run it under hot water. The trimmer does seem a bit under powered and does work better when you pop off the razor head. I am very satisfied with the razor and included travel case. Bottom line - if you are already a norelco style user looking to trade up, go for it.

In the end, zero advantage of buying it if you are looking for a wireless mirror (I already have a wired one which i was trying to replace) unless you are willing to change batteries all the time.
Its nice looking mirror overall if you are going for a vanity decoration

For $17.99 you get over 20 plates each having about 6 designs. The edges are a bit sharper than Konad and some of the designs feel like they aren't deep enough because the stamp doesn't pick up the design right away.  Konad templates are about 6 bucks each so this is a super steal.  I can't wait to get the Konad designs plates too. Its all super fun and pretty easy to use.

title: caveat emptor
text:
This machine is all right if you like to shave three times a day. Otherwise, stick with your blade.

The famous pivoting heads do not actually pivot much, so upper neck, jaw and chin are a real challenge to trim. And two hours later, you feel like you need a shave.

Also, the elaborate cleaning/oiling recommended by the User's Manual will have you longing for the simplicity of your razor.

Further, the cost of replacing heads is a hidden cost. Also, the need to purchase the oil and cleaning supplies. They do not come with the machine.

Finally, the User's Manual (even though labeled 9160 XL) does not square with the machine supplied.

Bottom line: If you're thinking of switching from razors to electric shavers, think again.

title: My favorite hair product - EVER.
text:
I absolutely adore this product. This is the ONLY hair mask / conditioning treatment that actually works on my hair. My hair is thin, fine, brittle, and dry -- some of that is genetics, some of it is because I was bleaching my hair and dying it. This product actually works. It makes my split ends feel soft and healthy again, and the rest of my hair is soft and manageable as well, and lasts the rest of the day! Some products feel like the wear off after a while, or doesn't enhance the softness at all. This product makes me want to touch my hair all day. I can easily run my fingers through it or brush my hair without it getting caught at the ends. I know this product is costly, but a little goes a long way.

I received all three products (the shampoo, conditioner, the mask) in a subscription box to try, and while all three products seem to work well together, the mask honestly works so well on its own that I don't even feel like I need the Oribe Gold Lust shampoo or conditioner. I used this product for two months last year until I ran out of my sample sizes. After I stopped using the product, there was definitely a noticeable change in the quality and softness of my hair during the time I did not have this product. I saved up enough money and just purchased another bottle, and even after ONE use, I can feel such an improvement in my hair already. A little goes a long way, and I am fairly certain that the product from Amazon is indeed 100% real and authentic. I am absolutely in love with this product.

Did I mention that it smells fantastic?

Sincerely,
The happiest of customers

title: Great razor for a reasonable price
text:
I bought this after my 10 year old Norelco's battery didn't last anymore. I usually leave my electric razor plugged into the wall, which is the reason I picked the 7140XL over the cheaper 7110X (which doesn't allow for corded-shaving).

The pros of my new 7140XL and my old model are:
- new razor seems to need less passes for a very close shave
- far quieter
- waterproof (don't plan on bringing it into the shower, though)
- the 3 shaving circles tilt and contour to your face instead of being 1 flat shaving surface

Cons:
- Cord is significantly shorter, so you'll end up placing the razor right next to your outlet to charge or use. It is about 1 foot in length coiled up (it's like a coiled telephone cord).

I would recommend this shaver.

You cannot go wrong with these lovely soaps.

Recommended.

title: Works as advertised and better
text:
I have been using a Norelco T370 trimmer for several months. I bought it for the mini-shaver initially, decided to grow a beard, then trimmed the beard with the beard trimmer attachment. It did a great job of shaping and trimming, but left a mess of clippings in the sink. After reading a million reviews, I decided to try the T980 for it's vacuum feature.

The T980 is great! It does a perfect job of trimming my beard evenly (setting at 7, ultimate beard length to be a 9). The best part is that about 90% of the clippings go into the vacuum receptical with only about 10% being lost. I have not come across any of the negatives (adjustment slips, tugs hairs and on and on) mentioned in other reviews. Unlike my T370, this trimmer lets you know when it's fully charged or about to go dead, and even if it does die in the middle of a session from a dead battery, plugging it in finishes the job. Most other trimmers only work when charged, not on house current.

I can't think of anything this trimmer could do better. In my estimation it's looks, design and operation are flawless. The clipper works well on my beard's 'neckline' and the mini-trimmer keeps the bottom of my mustache trimmed perfectly. I really think the T370 does as good a job trimming as this one does, but will not run with a dead battery when plugged in, and does make a mess with beard clippings all over the place. For those two reasons alone, this trimmer is a BEST BUY!

I am not putting the T370's abilities down in any way. For the price it can't be beat. It trims well and the mini-shaver is still the best way to shave the short hairs on my cheeks above my beard on a daily basis. I use it daily along with the T980 and will continue to. They both have their place. If you don't mind the beard trimmings everywhere, you will be happy with the T370, however if you are serious about perfect beard grooming (and I DO mean PERFECT), with none of the mess, both tools are a must.

text: I'm new to nail polish and this was the first time I EVER did my nails with gel polish. I have had professional applications but never do I paint my own nails, like on a rare occasion I'd use clear polish or a light glitter so believe me I'm brand new to all this nail stuff. This powder is AMAZING and so beautiful. I found it helpful to cure the top coat for half the time, apply the powder more saturated at the nail tip and rub upward to the cuticle with the applicator tip to help buff the powder. A little powder goes a long way and next time I will apply MUCH less powder, too much powder gives a metallic look. I had a more sheer halo look which Ioved but I messed up the other hand and had apply more powder to even the look out lol. My nails didn't come out perfect because I'm very inexperienced in nail care but I'm really happy with the results and will continue to practice. I highly recommend this powder. I used gellen gel polish romantic color set, gellen base and top coat and the sunuv 48 watt smart lamp 2.0 and this powder.  I had sucess with all these products. I was hesitant to try the powder after spend so much time with the gel polish but I'm really glad I played with it. I'll will definitely order this again. Just try it, it's fun. The only down side is that you will become obsessed looking at your nails. I got outside specifically to see the pretty halo twinkle at me in the bright sun light haha 🤩

title: Roll on Wax Bar
text:
The wax warmer is very color pleasing and so are the bars of wax that go inside the warmer itself. It comes with two roll on wax bars, along with finishing wipes (just oil towel) and a pack of paper. The directions are very easy to read on how to use the wax warmer but the pack of papers is awful in the direction department. So many spelling/grammar errors - but the pictures are more explanatory then the actual words themselves.

It took about 5-8 minutes for the wax to melt and be at a good use of temperature. I would wait until MAX temperature and then wait a few more minutes for the wax to go on smoother. Then slap the paper on.

Now, you are wondering why 3 stars?

1. The time it takes to warm up - 1 Star
2. The materials that are given plus directions - 2 Star

If you are doing a spot on shave sure go ahead but to do your entire leg and not to mention BOTH of them, you will be sitting for a very long time. Its too time consuming and I am impatience. I would suggest to buy more papers if you are thinking about getting this. I do feel that it is a learning curve and that is ok, I will continue to learn how to do it.

It does work though, works decently well once the wax is at the perfect temperature. Oh its not painless, but it is tolerable if you have a high pain tolerance, but if you DO NOT, I would suggest waxing to not be your thing.

title: GREAT toothbrush!
text:
This is a great toothbrush! I have gingivitis and after only ONE use I could see improvement. In addition, it took off every bit of plaque that I could see, i.e. I thought my front bottom gums were really clean and when toothbrush was done, I saw that they weren't as clean as could they could have been.

I hate to floss ("I don't have time right now!") and this does it for me.

In regards to the timer, I had no idea how long two minutes was! It sounds like nothing, and yet I waited and waited for the timer - I thought it was broken but it wasn't; it showed me how me I DON'T take to brush my teeth. Great feature.

The one thing that is kind of hard to get used to is that you just run the toothbrush over your teeth/gums/tongue and I (quite naturally) am used to the back and forth way of brushing and I kept finding myself having to stop working and let the toothbrush do its work.

To sum up, for anyone wanting to get their teeth REALLY clean and not have to put a lot of maintenance into it, you should really think about investing in this toothbrush. It's a really great toothbrush! I KNOW my dentist is going to be happy.

title: Other Indy Top Coats Are Better
text:
I purchased because I was trying to find a top coat that was more long lasting in the bottle and more friendly to work with. And this product is both of those things - it's easy to work with and doesn't dry out in the bottle. But, I have two issues that make this unusable for me.

First is a personal preference - I prefer for a top coat to be super hard when dry. I have super soft flexible nails and top coats that dry to a hard plastic-like finish give my nails structure to avoid tears and bends. Seche Vite is not this. It's thin and stays too flexible for my needs.

Second is an objective problem - shrinkage. After about a day, this top coat shrinks. It pulls away from the edges of my nails, either exposing the polish underneath or pulling the polish with it. This leads to chipping and lifting. Searching online I found this is a common problem that people face with this product.

Instead, I'm going to stick with other brands until I find my goldilocks (if there are people with my above concerns, I'm currently trying Glisten & Glow and I'm pleased so far).

title: As A Costume Wig You Can't Fault It!
text:
So I wear and review a lot of wigs and I have started breaking the review down into sections that I think will be helpful. Note this wig comes with Spider Clip (on large braid in picture), earrings, and a silver necklace (also pictured) - Not pictured - 2 clip in thin braids that I didn't use.

Color - Purple and black - obviously supposed to be a Mary Sanderson look from Hocus Pocus (although hers is a little redder) - not named as such though probably for licensing reasons.

Styling- This is a take out the bag and put on ready to go wig. There is an adjustable band at the back with minimal adjusment but it was enough to fit it securly. The style is perfect and ready to go and needed next to no effort to make it look natural.

Comfort - Fit well and would easily be wearable all day. Super light as the cap is very airy because of the ready to go style.

Overall - I LOVE this. I can't believe for a costume wig this would be so fabulous. It's instantly recognizable and the accessories were a bonus!

title: Makes my feet tingle
text:
Pumice stone (made in Korea)
It's a regular pumice stone; if you've seen one, you've seen them all. This one fits in the hand nicely and has a pleasant minty scent. I admit I've never found these very useful, and probably won't use it much because they're hard to clean. The one I received is smoother and a different shape from the one in the picture.

Wooden foot massager (made in China)
I used to have a similar one and lost it, so this was one of the reasons I bought the kit. I like this a lot because the ridges are not as deep/pointed as they are on some rollers. It's relaxing without being painful, and feels great on the sides of the feet too. I even like rolling it between my hands. My only complaint is that the wood is a tiny bit rough in places. Not anything I feel when using it, however.

Wooden foot brush (made in China)
I was disappointed in this brush because the one I received has flaws in the wood that make it look grimy. If I were buying this set in a shop, I would have looked through them all and picked one without a damaged brush. However, it's still functional and the bristles are a nice balance between stiff and soft. You can use it to clean your toenails or simply brush it on your feet to get the blood circulating.

Tea tree oil foot scrub (made in the USA)
This is really nice, it has a fine grit that works well without irritating. You get a full size tube and don't use a lot at a time, so this will last a while.

Tea tree oil foot balm (made in the USA)
This is the star of the show, it's heavenly. Smells refreshingly minty, makes your skin soft. Works on any dry skin, not just feet. I couldn't resist using a lot of this, so even though you get a lot, I have a feeling I'll be buying more fairly soon. I really notice the difference right away. I can easily see this becoming a must-have staple.

Bag
It comes in a plastic bag with a green cord drawstring. The plastic is thick enough to make it reusable, though the foot massager sticks out the top. It's nothing special, but sturdy enough to store the set.

Overall
All together, the kit is very relaxing to use after a stressful day. I'm definitely going to check out more of the Earth Therapeutics products that are made in the USA.

The balm and scrub are both vegan, however the brush has boar bristles, so this would NOT be a good gift for a vegan. However, it would be a great unisex gift for just about anyone else, especially people who are on their feet all day.

title: This is the best razor for me
text:
Everyone's experience with a razor is different. I've tried a lot of different types, and I was more than happy to let go of my Gillette Fusion Power early last year. I bought a Shick Hydro Power. I thought it was great, cheap all around with an amazing cut. I even have the highest rated review on the product on Amazon currently. Now, I looked at the reviews for this saying Hydro 5 is better. It might be better for one person or another, but I have used both extensively and like this one better.

I have been using the Proglide POWER (yes, power) version for about 6-7 months now. I just purchased this manual version to take with me to basic training (in case the power version would be confiscated). I'll backtrack and talk about my experience with the Hydro 5. When I used it at first, it was kind of rough. I figured it would get a little better and it did, but it still was uncomfortable. I fooled myself into liking it because of its price and how long the lubrication strip lasted. I was getting only a week on my Fusion Power before it started to become uncomfortable because the strip faded out, and I was getting 3-4 weeks with the Hydro 5 until it ran out. The lubrication on that thing is funny though, because sometimes the whole thing will fall out of the razor.

My experience with the Proglide has been positive in every way as soon as I took it out of the box. I have learned long ago to not hype up any product until I've used it for a long time. With 6-7 months of experience I'm telling everyone how it is. The proglide can cut through thick stubble as good as it does on your 5 o clock shadow. I hadn't shaved for about a week and used the Proglide and it cut me down smooth with no pain and with ease. I bought myself a replacement pack of 8 cartridges and I have run through 6. That means in 6 months, I have used 6. Actually 7 if you include the one it came with. For those of you out there who know how to make a razor last, one of these can go up to a month or two. For beginners or average shavers, you will get at least two weeks worth before you even consider changing it, and, the lubrication will still be there.

One thing I hated about the Hydro 5 was the grip. It was a horrible design. With the Proglide, it was made with you in mind. It just feels natural holding it, and every stroke feels just right. As we all know, replacing Gillette cartridges can be a pain in the neck (not physically). To buy a pack of replacements, you're looking at about $30 for a pack of 8. The same will cost you under $20 with the Hydro 5. Not everyone cares to pay for it, but it's more than worth it. It's the best shave I ever had in my life, and I don't mind paying $10 extra every 6-9 months for a better experience.

Think of razors like gas, and you are the car. You only require regular gas, but if you decide to go with the premium (Proglide), your car will run faster and be more responsive.

I will state again I have not used the manual proglide yet, but it's the same thing without vibration (which I don't use much anyway).

Hopefully your experience is as good as mine.

Here is a run down of stats in my own opinion for the Proglide.

Fusion Proglide
Standard: $9.74 (comes with 2 cartridges)- replacement pack of 8 - $28.99
Power: $10.94 (1 cartridge) - replacement pack of 8 - $31.99

Comfort level: 5/5
Effectiveness of each stroke: 4.5/5 (sometimes you have to run the blade back over)
Smoothness of shave: 5/5 - Your experience may be different, but this is the best shave of my life
Cartridge life: 4/5 - Depends on how you use it. Will get you 2 weeks minimum and up to 2 months maximum
Design: 5/5 - The thing I hate about most razors is the design. This one feels great in hand

Overall: 4.8/5 - It's not perfect, but the best razor I've ever used in my life

It comes out of box with a razor holder which most gillette razors have, but others don't. Also, I strongly recommend buying the Proglide shaving cream. it's the best I ever used in my life. You can literally see your hairs rising in seconds if you look closely.

Good luck everyone!

text: I purchased the 7d head shaver and after about 2 months of semi-regular use and cleaning as specified by the manufacturer, the device can hardly get a grip on my hair to shave and has developed an incredibly irritating high pitched whine/screech to it. It was loud and annoying when I first turned it on but I could deal with it as the cost of having an electric shaver, I never expected it to be silent. This new shrieking noise is unacceptable. It always took multiple passes to get a decent clean shave on my head, but now it takes an exponentially greater amount of passes with the shaver to get anywhere close to a shave with this device. The accessories, when used with a light touch as described in the manual, have also developed structural issues and are also unusable. One can expect this device to last about 2 months before becoming garbage.

I have loved these SSEN clips since the first time I used them. They are truly the perfection of all hair clips. My search for the exact right clip is complete. All of the eight exciting colors of SSEN clips are welcome in my business anytime.

They sanitize easily and really are made well so they last and last.
I have never written a review for hair clips; however, I truly could not have a higher recommendation and opinion of these SSEN clips.

Kathleen

I'm extremely pleased with the effectiveness of the product. However it's too expensive to use for everyday since my guess is I'll only get about 6-7 sessions from the bottle. I'm definitely interested in making my own spray as others have noted is possible.

I travel a lot for business and yes, I will pack this with me wherever I go.

title: Amazing serum
text:
This Retinol serum is a combination of retinol and natural ingredients for a high-strength serum containing repairing agents for wrinkled, non-elastic, and stressed skin. It is designed to provide smoother-looking skin and rejuvenate aged and dull skin.

In addition to retinol, this serum contains Aloe, Hyaluronic Acid, Vitamin E and Green Tea for gentle and effective hydration. Hyaluronic acid is a glycosaminoglycan, a very long chain of disaccharides (sugars) present in all connective tissues that is responsible for retaining moisture. As we age, levels of hyaluronic acid fall—some say by as much as 50 percent. Genetics, smoking, and magnesium and zinc deficiencies appear to accelerate this loss, but it happens to all of us to some degree.

One of the benefits of hyaluronic acid is its effectiveness at maintaining healthy, youthful skin. The reason is because hyaluronic acid is an essential component of the skin. Thanks to its ability to promote collagen production and retain hundreds of times its weight in water, hyaluronic acid keeps the skin plumped up and hydrated.

The combined benefits of these ingredients make for an amazing anti-aging and nourishing moisturizer for your skin.

title: WOW - works great and the Turbo Vacuum keeps it neat!
text: Got this as a replacement for a 10+ year old Conair beard trimmer that finally was unable to hold a charge anymore.  My only real requirement was that it had to be able to be used corded OR cordless, for those times when you realize you shouldn't look like a deadbeat just as you are about to walk out the door, only to find out that the unit needs charging!  The beard cutting is very uniform, seems to be plenty of height adjustment settings, and about 95% of the trimmings magically got sucked into the little chamber instead of all over my bathroom counter, which is a huge boost for my marriage!  Feels a little plastic-y, not cheap but not as solid as my old unit - will be fine if you are not an equipment trasher and as long as you pay a little attention when sliding the moveable pieces off and on and make sure you have them in the right groove.  Hope I get another 10 years out of this one!

title: Brushes are Nice but hard to keep clean
text:
The brushes work well-- However, they're the first tooth brush i've ever had where I've had the problem of small bits of food getting stuck in between the bristles. Rinsing alone doesn't get them out and I have to use a little pick to fish them out. Otherwise I really like the experience of using them, I just don't know if they will really be more sanitary than a regular tooth brush if food particles can rot inside of it.

Update: I've lowered it to 3 stars as they are really quite unhygienic with how difficult it is to remove small food particles from them. Today, I finally found the best way: with a water flosser. Ugh, so much stuff came out despite the fact I had been trying very hard to keep it clean and remove debris with my dental pick. You shouldn't need a $30+ gadget to be able to keep your tooth brush from getting so filthy so quick.

title: Good idea but poorly executed vials
text:
The little vials of the whitening agent are very poorly designed - I had one that was leaking, and one that the brush portion was stuck in the lid so it couldn't be used (there was just a little "pipe" in the "goo" part). The remaining ones worked but it's very hard to get all of the "goo" out so you end up wasting it - think of a toothpaste tube which was solid plastic and couldn't be squeezed! Once you do get it to come out, the "brush" really just makes the stuff clump and glob up - it doesn't just brush on like you'd expect.

Once you get the chemical out and use the system it works well, but I've lost so much of the chemical to bad packaging that now I need to order another set of vials to finish the treatment. It's not cheap, unfortunately, so I hope that they come up with a better packaging method for future purchasers so there isn't so much wasted whitening agent.

title: Not my favorite lash serum
text:
This is the second brand of eyelash growth serum I've tried, and decided to try this brand because it was considerably cheaper. This is another example of "you get what you pay for".
In the past I have used Rapidlash. I was amazed at how long and full my lashes were after only a few weeks. I'd say it took about 3 weeks for it to really show, and the results were amazing. Over time I got a little lazy and took my new full, long lashes for granted and stopped using Rapidlash. Gradually my lashes returned to their normal short, thin condition.
I knew I needed to start using lash growth serum again and decided to try Uptown Eyelash Growth Serum. It was cheaper, and advertised longer, thicker lashes in just two weeks.
It's been about 3 weeks ... and, yes, my lashes are somewhat thicker and longer. If I hadn't tried Rapidlash in the past, I would think lash serum a waste of money. Not really enough difference to justify the price or inconvenience. What this experience did show me is that there are great lash serums out there, this just doesn't appear to be one of them.

title: The best trimmer I've yet used.
text:
First off, I have to say I'm severely disappointed with some of the other reviews of this product, as I have found them to be light years from my experience with this trimmer. Thus far, I have found it to be well designed, well built and very easy to use. Also to my surprise, the vaccum works just great! Yes, there are still hairs that hit the sink, but whadda ya want, perfection? The vaccum collects easily two-thirds to three-quarters of the trimmed hair and that's a good thing.

That said, I've found the most impressive aspect of the trimmer is the extended precision trimming head. While not as wide as the standard trimming head, it extends the cutting edge far enough away from the body of the trimmer to provide the easiest and most accurate edge trimming I've ever experienced. Outlining my beard, moustache and sideburns is suddenly a far easier and more precise task. For any guy who either wants or needs cleaner lines on his facial hair, this is an excellent choice!

I'm still getting used to the length selector and how to get the desired look before having to take off the guide comb and switch trimmer heads to get a more precise cut, but I'm sure that will come with time. It operates in much the same way as my previous Norelco trimmer, but the body design of this trimmer fits much better in the hand, and the guide comb assembly provides a much more comfortable trim as I glide it over my chin. It's also a wonderful thing to have the fast 1 hour recharge time!

The only downside I've found so far is some irritation of the skin while using the extended trimmer head. It's a VERY sharp head and can nick you if you're not careful, but I put that in the still-learning-how-to-use-it category. This is truly a great trimmer, so to all my proudly facially hirsute brothers, I say don't believe the nay-sayers and pick this puppy up!

title: mostly satisfied - has common design flaws
text:
this is not the 'model' I received. I received the version with 1 large compartment on the front (as opposed to the pictured 2 compartments). I was packing for a job, and wanted to use right away so I did not contact seller to see about an exchange.

as usual, whoever makes stylist's bags does not seem to test the spaces with actual tools inside, fully loaded - as most stylist would use it. the right side has a heat resistant pocket for hot tools. it fits my flat iron & a standard length curling iron (mine must be long as it sticks out the top). difficult to use with tools still hot as the cords really have no space other than inside this pocket. there are envelope slots in the 'door' of this compartment. I have tried to fit a brush ... but it quickly becomes too bulky and difficult to zipper shut.

I use zucca cases inside the main compartment which work fine. I specifically ordered this because it was soft-sided ... but that means when fully loaded, it collapses easily and I really watch how I set it up. also, as I am using it with zucca bags (as opposed to the boxes shown) - getting into just one bag at a time is difficult since they rely on being stacked just so. my zucca bags do not protrude out of the compartment, but fit snuggly in which, again, becomes a problem when using the pockets & accompanying bags that are in this front 'door'. I usually have to lay the bag back to get it zipped close (like the 80's - laying on the bed to zipper your pants!! C-: )

it seems sturdy enough; the proportions of the backpack aspect are good and I really like the heavy duty top handle. time will tell ... my zucca case started coming apart at the seams after just 1 year. hoping this one is better reinforced

title: Nothing better, in any way.
text:
It's September, 2020. I bought this soap in November of 2017 and use it once in a while, somewhat for giving myself a special treat. I have gone on to discover numerous artisan shaving soaps, and they are very enjoyable.

Last night, I shaved with Mitchell's Woolfat for the first time in maybe 3 months or so. The scent is, as it's always been very natural (as if out of nature itself) and relaxing. I loaded up a slightly moistened shave brush and proceeded to face lather, adding drops of water onto the brush from time to time to produce a fully optimized lather. The result left nothing at all to be desired, even in view of my experience with, as I said, numerous artisan shaving soaps. The slickness, the thickness, the cushion and the residual slickness were/are no less than what the most celabrated artisan shaving soaps deliver. Great protection during the shave and no lesser than the best post-shave feel that is experienced with the exclusive, higher priced shaving soaps. Shaving with Mitchell's Woolfat shaving soap is as good as it gets.

title: Let It Work For You!
text: This product promises to firm up your face, neck & chest skin against the natural sagging that occurs with age, and it does! That said, it's not a miracle preparation and must be used twice a day on clean skin as the base layer to your daily moisturizers for it to work best. And you must stay with it for it to work lastingly I discovered. Depending on each persons unique complexion it can act as soon as 72 hrs to see obvious signs of firmness. My throat skin was sagging and it was easily visible in photos taken while on a studio tour, I was horrified at my appearance and after significant internet research, felt that this product was capable of doing what I hoped for at a price-point I could afford. So I ordered it and used it lavishly the first, and happily within two weeks my sagging throat skin was again firmly up against my throat itself. As I've stayed with using it, it has remained so while used in tandem with the Anew Platinum face moisturizer line I've progressed to using. I also touch it to the circles around my eyes with it to firm them up, as well as on my brow-bone/upper eye lids to keep my lids off my upper lashes and also to harness under-eye bags from becoming puffy from restless nights. Again it's worked and my eyes've remained reasonably smooth and line-free by using it with the Anew Multi Performance Eye Cream that's worked well for me during the past couple of years. I believe most moisturizer users try to extend their beauty products by using them sparingly which underserves their intended purpose - I know I have! But to use it generously the first several weeks allows them to saturate & nourish our thinner, more delicate facial skin so it can be refreshed with these formulas intended to help us look our very best always. I used 2 bottles of this serum during the first month, then 1 1/2 bottles the next  6 wks, and have settled on not quite a bottle from 4 - 6 wks depending on the weather. With diligence and generosity this product has worked for me. As I'm now 60, and after a 36 yr career of working outside in all weather, I'm thrilled when people marvel that I'm actually my age because in their words, "you look so young!" So use your beauty products enough to let them work for You.

title: Phenomenal!
text: I've tried many sheet masks, but this one is a standout. I was looking for pearl as an ingredient in a sheet mask, and it's hard to find.  I read a lot of reviews before purchasing.  It is loaded with essence (many of them are), but these masks are different in their results.  I honestly see the little fine lines under my eyes gone after using them.  They stay gone the next day or so, too.  I know, that sounds hard to believe, but for me, it's true. And there is some brightening effect, too, and definitely calmed redness and... spider veins.  Your results may vary, but it wouldn't hurt to try these masks if you've developed broken capillaries.  Certainly there is "plumping", and my skin is bouncy and supple the next morning. I will say that after removing the mask and patting, the essence stays a bit tacky, but with these results I don't mind.  Essence that remains in the packet I use the next night as one of my serum steps.  I certainly will reorder.

title: These WILL hold on!
text:
I've been experimenting with glue-free and magnetic-free lashes and I really enjoyed using this product! Is it my absolute favorite? At the time of writing this review, so far, yes!

I really like the formula of the eyeliner, it has been one of the smoothest I have tried so far. As for the strength of the adhesiveness of the eyeliner with the lashes, it is super strong! Even the slightest touch of the lash to the eyeliner will have it STUCK! The eyeliner also is very water and smudge proof!

I have only taken one star off because the lash band itself can be a little bit irritating for people with small eyelids/monolids. While wearing these lashes, the inner corner of my eyes were feeling a bit irritated because the band was poking the skin. Eventually this made my eye water, and the inner corners of the eyelash were beginning to peel up. I feel that if I readjusted these lashes, or cut some portion off, it would help with the issue.

title: Great Moisturizer for Oily Skin and Daytime Use
text:
My teenage daughter had a bad reaction to Benzoyl Peroxide acne creams. It made her skin severely dry, red and itchy. She has greasy skin so we were looking for an oil-free moisturizer that would help with her irritated skin. This Recovery Moisturizer was a good choice.

It looks like a white gel but when you apply it to the face it absorbs clear. It wasn’t sticky and it soothed her redness and itching.

The ingredients say it has aloe vera and all sorts of things but we were happy that there was no fragrance.

The tube is a good size (2 ounces) but she was using it on her face and all over her back so it ran out pretty quickly.

We would recommend this product to anyone with irritated or sensitive skin.

title: Does not feel like it can straighten hair at the roots but love the low heating temp.
text:
I have tried a number of these brushes. What I like about this one is that it goes down to 80C (176F). It was so cool that I was not sure it was on. I have fine hair, high porosity that is 5 months post-straightening relaxer. And, I find that light heat with a silicone-based glosser helps to gently close the cuticle and to keep my roots from tangling. What I don’t like is that this brush design does not have the round guiding bristles around the edges that help to pull your hair into the hearing plate. So, it feels like you are brushing your hair with your elbow and that it is not penetrating to the roots. You have to grip the hair with your other hand so it feels like you are only getting the shaft of your hair. So, the brush is best for people with longer hair who do not have curly roots or those who need the super low heat setting as an option.

If you would like to be able to rake the brush over your roots to tame curls at 250 F and up, other bushes to consider are https://www.amazon.com/gp/product/B07FGV9NQG/ref=ppx_yo_dt_b_asin_title_o01_s00?ie=UTF8&th=1 or https://www.amazon.com/gp/product/B071HFQGJX/ref=ppx_yo_dt_b_asin_title_o00_s00?ie=UTF8&psc=1. Note - My glamfields brush malfunctioned after first use which is why I ended up trying this one, but I decided to give Glamfields another chance because it is great when it works - never had results like that before. The BuTure mini is like the Glamfields brush but smaller. Both feel better (more like a real brushZ) than this one.

title: Kaeline is great!!!
text:
This past summer my family and I spent two weeks in Morocco. During that time we visited women's cooperatives that were producing argan oil products near the beach town of Essouirra. Of course, I bought some products. Upon our return to the United States, I was disappointed to find that I could not purchase argan oil beauty products domestically. Then, to my great surprise I found that one company--Xandra Renouvelle--had become the sole distributor of Kaeline argan oil products in the US. Since August I have NOT stopped using Kaeline products. The Kaeline argan oil products have reduced the number of perimenopausal breakouts that I've experienced each month. I've used Kaeline argan oil on my occasional cold sores and have found it more effective than the more popular cold sore medications. Kaeline has also improved the texture of my hair and provided desparately needed moisture to my arms and legs.

I support Kaeline's mission in that it derives its argan oil from wholly owned and run women's cooperatives in Morocco. These cooperatives are designed to provide income to women, many of whom are single mothers or widows.

Kaeline is certified by EcoCert, a European agency that supports organic and fair trade products.

Since discovering discovering argan oil, I have remained a faithful customer of Kaeline.

title: Even good for thick hair!
text:

I was concerned this small brush (bristle area is only about 4.5 inches long or so, each bristle is about 1 inch long) but wow okay, this actually worked. I hopped out of the shower and towel dried, hair only slightly damp/leaning towards dry, and used this brush on the middle heat setting. Just a few seconds running it through (and I go through thick portions of hair at a time) and it worked!

I love how easy it is to use because for my kind of hair I just can’t stand doing the classic round brush/hair dryer combo (arms end up hurting or it slips) or the flatiron alone (which takes FOREVER to do my hair). This brush does the job of both so well.

This is a small but mighty brush! Light in my hands. Material looks and feels pretty top notch too. Cord is swivel, so no tangling, and it’s smooth rubber, not crappy stiff plastic like I tend to see. I really like this brush and I’m excited to take it along with me on trips too!

This is great wax. I've used it on my legs, underarms, and upper lip. It gets almost all the hair and down to the root. DO NOT listen to the instructions. Be warned though, I used nearly half of it for just my lower legs. You do go through it quickly because you need a good layer on there in order to get all the hair and remove it in one sweep.

title: Whats the deal with the hype of this? AVOID!
text:
Okay so I received this about 6 weeks ago.

First impressions:
Upon opening my package, I noticed the box was already sort of opened and not sealed... I assumed it's because it is a cheap product. I also noticed that in the serum, I had white clumps which I assumed was due to the freezing temperatures outside at the time. I also noticed this product had a very astringent smell -- similar to alcohol.

Usage:
I had been using it twice daily after cleansing, toning, and my essence. I am used to using a serum, but this product seriously made my face super red every time I applied it. I assumed it was due to a niacin conversion on my skin, but after a couple weeks, I started breaking out more than ever. I noticed that my skin was completely sensitive, red, and everything would sting my face. I did not think it was this product at first, but after i stopped using this product completely, the redness and sensitivity stopped.

Conclusion:
Do not buy this product. In my case, this product made my skin worse than it has ever been along with being super crazy sensitive. I do not recommend this to anyone, but perhaps I received a bad batch? The lot/manufacturing stamp on the product is "8LB" if anyone with the same lot/manufacturing stamp is having a similar issue...
However, if you are looking for a niacinamide+zinc formula, I would recommend Revolution Skincare Niacinamide+Zinc from Ulta instead. I have now been using that for about 3 weeks without any of the same issues from the Ordinary.

The length was nice for each bundle , I got
16.18,20 inches and a 14” frontal
Frontal was really good and I only had to pluck a little!
Hair had a hair smell or like perm smell to it , or something but all I did was wash it with conditioner and it was fine.
I bleached this hair and dyded it Blue.
Bleaching process went well and the hair took the clean fine . I dyed it and it still was fine.

Basically the hair is lovely , it’s soft, easy to dye, style, bundles are thick, I haven’t curled this hair yet, so idk how the curls are or will hold. I’m going to try n upload a video . But I will order this hair again!

Mirenesse Power Lift Treatment Cream protects my skin from the elements, moisturizes without breaking me out.  If I put it on at night, my skin is visibly improved and brighter in the morning.  My only complaint is that the price has increased drastically over the years, you used to be able to buy it for around $15-20.  So I tend to use it less often now and alternate with Cetaphil Moisturizing Cream (green lid), but it still works great when my skin needs a boost.
