title: In less than 24 hours I'm obsessed!
text:
I've had this day cream for less than 24 hours... so I may be jumping the gun but I'm already so amazed I just had to review!

I am in my mid-20's with sensitive dry skin that breaks out in zits and/or hives if you simply just look at it wrong. My previous face cream has either been discontinued or moved to some obscure unfindable website. So I took a leap of faith trying this rose day cream. And oh my goodness, I am so happy I did! My face has never been so soft and clear and... glowy! I feel like I have an entirely new face, and in under 24 hours no less!

This cream is very concentrated. I only need to gently tap the cream with my fingertip once or twice to cover my entire face and neck. It may smell like something your grandmother or great grandmother would have enjoyed... if your grandmother had good taste. It is an absolutely delightful true rose smell (reminds you of the roses your beau would give you) and not at all overpowering. The cream feels a bit greasy at first and you may have to wait a minute to be able to apply make up afterwards but once it settles in, it takes about as long as it does to towel dry your hair, your face feels and looks like dewy perfection. I can't believe nobody told me about this stuff! I guess I'll have to start telling my friends about it myself. I wish I had before and after pictures to show you what a difference it made.

Upon further investigation of the company, Rose Valley Land, I'm now pining after their eye cream and shower gel. I may end up buying every product they have over the next few months as I finish off what I already have.

title: Cute, comfy, stay on well
text: So far (after excitedly trying all of them on right after each other) I really like these headbands! The colors and patterns are so cute. The striped ones are a silkier fabric while the floral printed ones are a more textured fabric. These don't stretch all the way around your head like many headbands do, you have to stretch it over your head around where you want it to be and then style your hair from there. Not the best pick for a quick hair fix, perhaps a standard elastic headband would be best for that! They seem to be pretty sturdy on the head; a lot of headbands can tend to slip around or even fall off. I didn't wear these for a long time, but I tested their strength by moving my head around and they stayed pretty much in place. They are a tad bit more narrow than I had anticipated, but you can sort of splat out the fabric if you like a wider headband like me. I attached a few of the pictures I took while trying them out. I love how they look with my hair both up and down! It adds a touch of flair and class to even a simple bun. Overall I really like these. They fit the style I was looking for with a great price. Definitely recommend!

title: Clean & lube your blades while running
text:
I am not a beautician or barber, just someone with 2 dogs needing regular clipping. I remember seeing this product or a similar one in barbershops where my Dad would go to get a haircut. It was in a good-sized flatish round jar and the barber would dip the tip and bottom of his clippers in it while running and they would come out shiny and hair free. Now the jar looked like a pot of disease waiting to get passed on to the next customer as it had floating bits of hair and residue from who knows what.

I had been cleaning and oiling my clipper blades after each grooming and using a coolant on them during clipping to keep the blade's surface from getting too hot. Cleaning the blades afterwards never seemed to get all the hair from between the teeth even using a tooth brush and sliding the two blades back and forth. This stuff really CLEANS all the hair off and you can hear that the blades are better lubricated by the reduced noise. I do wipe them quickly so as not to drip any of the H42 onto the dog. They are shining and humming pleasantly after dipping them into this stuff. I will continue to buy this product as I feel it will extend the life of my clippers and make for a better cutting blade.

Now for the down side and why I took off one star. This stuff still comes in the good sized flatish round "tub-like" container and is seems intended that you dip the blades (not the motor, just the blade tips and bottom) into the whole container full and continue to reuse this stuff over multiple cuts. I don't care if it is Virucidal and Anti-bacterial, that seems like a really unclean way to use this. I solve this problem by pouring a small amount into another container (at least 1/4 inch deep) and dip my clippers in that. I discard the stuff after each groom. Unfortunately the container it comes in does not pour without dripping and yes, you use more of this stuff using my method. I continue to use oil and coolant, but this stuff truly cleans off the bits that get between the teeth and seems to get the blades running much smoother. I do recommend this product, but not for using the reservoir full repeatedly over several cuts or clippings. That method just doesn't sound like a healthy way to go. So if you use clippers on humans or dogs, I feel this product may be of use to you.

title: Very generous for a sample kit. Provides two shades of light-toned foundation to try.
text:
While a sample set, the amount you receive is actually quite generous. There are two different shades of beige here for foundation, a very light 'all-purpose' powder, several eyeshadows, a bronzer, a package of travel-size brushes, and sheer setting powder. I would consider the eyeshadows full-size really and each jar is packed to full capacity, but does not have a little plastic cover on top so be careful when opening them!

It took some experimenting on my end to see what worked for me. With my skin tone, I have two different shades between summer and winter. My summer foundation is now too dark, so I purchased this because I go between light to medium depending on the sun/weather. What works for me is using the lightest foundation as a base, the medium beige as natural color 'bronzer' for normal sunkissed areas, then the all-purpose as a highlighter. The coverage is amazing for the price and hides my under eye circles quite well. I have not used the actual bronzer since it's rather dark and dramatic, but if you're into contouring like that, it should be fine. The finishing powder is nice as well, but I prefer a setting spray to get rid some of the drying effect of mineral make-up.

I also recommend you use a primer and a moisturizer beforehand, letting it dry for a bit before using the powders. My acne medication causes dry patches and the first attempt I did with just primer made it pretty obvious. I also didn't use the brushes because I have my own set as well.

title: Nice smell, but not very moisturizing
text:
To preface, I bought this product for when my hands or feet randomly get dry, and it seems I'll have to keep searching for a better product. Ultimately, I discarded this product. I do not recommend this because it did not moisturize my hands or feet. TIP: The best way to know if a product is good for your skin is to use it on your hands, feet, and/or face, since those are the most sensitive and picky areas (skin-wise) of the body. It dried out my hands and feet quickly after use, so I knew it would have the same effect on the rest of my body even if the effect is not as noticeable in other areas.

I tried to use this product when my hands or feet got dry. I like being in cold environments, so I often have lotion or something on standby for when my hands or feet inevitably get dry. Whenever I used this, my hands became dry again after about 30 minutes, when I expect it to last at least an hour like other products I've tried. So I decided this moisturizer is not for me and I ended up throwing this away.

Environmental considerations aside, I did not mind the glitter in the product. I just wish they focused more on the product actually working vs it looking pretty upon application.

title: Works Well on Dry, Cracked Heels
text:
I have for years dealt with dry, cracked heels, and I have tried a number of things to correct the issue. While my heels haven’t hurt or anything, they have been ugly. In a search for solutions, I found this foot scrubber and decided it was likely going to work better for me than a foot rasp, and I ordered it. It’s a great tool and it works well, though I do offer some caution for those who haven’t worked with a foot scrubber or rasp in the past.

This is an odd-looking instrument, vaguely similar to a comma in shape. The scraping side somewhat resembles a mirror with a patterned rough edge. It feels a lot like an emery board though it has more of a “bite” to the surface, if that makes sense. The overall size and shape make it easy to grip and hold, even when wet.

The first time I used it, I scraped away a fairly large amount of dead skin, to the point that I had feeling in parts of my heels where I have had no feeling for quite some time. It left my heels soft, pink and looking much better. However, I did discover that one can overdo, and I had nicked myself on each heel in one or two places, just enough to require blotting but not enough to really be a concern (it was less serious than a cut while shaving).

I discovered the following day what happens when you remove too much dead skin and don’t put enough lotion on an area that deals with weight and stress – my heels split in a couple of places and I ended up having difficulty walking without pain for a couple of days. I had put high-quality lotion on my heels, but apparently not enough. That was entirely my mistake, and it was a painful one.

After that finally healed up, I tried again. I have fallen into a daily routine where I gently scrub my heels for a couple of minutes each, then apply lotion. My heels now look much better, they’re not splitting when I put weight on them, and I have avoided nicking myself. At least in my case this is not a tool that gets used intensely every couple of weeks, but rather it is a daily tool that gets used very gently.

I got curious and put this tool under a digital microscope to see what the rough surface looked like. The roughness resembles a series of crescents, not dissimilar to a rasp, but much more fine.

This thing really works and it does a good job. It’s slightly more expensive than the average foot rasp but it seems to work well. I do recommend using some caution when working with this instrument as it is possible to overdo if not careful, which is probably very true of any tool of this type.

title: Not the super-exfoliator I wanted
text: I was not impressed with this foot mask. It claims to be exfoliating, so I expected it to work like other foot exfoliating masks I’ve used in the past. The other foot masks are used like these are - there’s a gel distributed inside some plastic booties. You open the top of the booties, put your feet in the booties, massage the gel through the bootie so your entire foot is covered with gel, tape the bootie closed around your ankle them sit back and relax for an hour or so. The other masks Ive used took about three days for the exfoliation to start - I would shed thin sheets of skin for several days and at the end be left with amazingly soft uncalloused feet. This did not happen with this product. No shedding, no exfoliation. My feet may have been a little softer immediately after washing off the product, but that is the only benefit I received. I thought maybe I didn’t do it right with the first set in this 3-pack, so a month later I got out another pair of booties, read the instructions super carefully, left on the booties for the longest recommenced time and waited to see if I’d get better results this time. Nope. Will go back to ordering one of my previous brands

title: Bad for Fragrance or Essential Oil Sensitivities - Nice Packaging, though
text:
I have not used this soap due to reasons listed below, and have started the return process. I only can comment on it's scent and packaging.

The Good:
- packaging looks very nice and well presented

The Bad:
- Heavy scent: Definitely has some sort of essential oil(s) in it.
- The ingredient "nervous" cannot be found in a Google search, and an answered question claimed that the ingredient "nervous" was a mistake. That answer is misleading, and made me believe this was free from chemicals and essential oils.

Overall:
If you have fragrance or essential oil sensitivities, you probably do not want to purchase this product, as there is definitely some sort of essential oil(s) in it. As soon as I opened the box, I had a reaction. Not fun. If you are not sensitive to fragrances or essential oils, this is probably okay. I am giving 3 stars because the product is well packaged and looks nice, however, I cannot give more stars due to the misleading information in the product description and answered questions.

title: Melts, causes rash and skin peeling
text: Like so many reviewers, I also experienced skin irritation, redness, and peeling. I contacted the company and was effectively gaslit, directed to a page on their website that describes contact dermatitis. I have never reacted this way to any other cosmetic product, have no history of allergies or sensitivities to skincare product ingredients, “natural” or otherwise, and have used products containing essential oils for many years with no adverse effects. My experience with Myro deodorant seemed much more akin to a chemical burn, as others here have described. When I reached out to Myro, they offered absolutely nothing to try to make the situation right. I am beyond disappointed with my experience. Further, the product itself was a wet, melty mess that leaked out of the container into my bathroom cabinet on a daily basis. The scents were pretty nice, and I liked the idea of minimizing packaging waste, but overall, this product along with the poor customer service was a major fail.

text:
I have used the norelco wet/dry shaver for over 6 years now. I first used it in Iraq, it was a Godsend. Yes, it obviously takes longer to shave than with a regular razor to get a good shave, but shaving everyday with a regular razor destroys my face. Once you get used to this razor, I assure you you will practically look forward to shaving. I have found that using a face cleanser (like Phisoderm or others) along with the moisturizer you load in the razor make the shave much nicer. I am overseas again in support of Afghanistan and travel all over the place. This razor holds up during my travels with no issues. It is more durable than you think. 1 charge lasts about 5/6 days, depending on how long you take to shave. They are not expensive, so I own two of them to ensure I always have one charged.

Again, great razor and highly recommended.

LTC John K

title: There's good and bad
text: I was immediately impressed with the packaging and presentation of this magnetic lash kit.  It was packaged nicely.  Comes with five pairs of 10 magnet lashes, an applicator, and two tubes of magnetic liner.  The lashes are nice, but a little too dramatic for my liking as they are.  I plan on trimming some and applying to the outer half of my eye to see if I can achieve a less dramatic, more comfortable look.  The applicator is a really good quality.  I don't like the liner at all.  It does have a scent and that seems to be common with these magnetic lash kits.  I was able to smell the liner for several hours after application and I can never figure out why the liners have a fragrance at all.  My eyes are extremely sensitive, so this adds to the irritation.  Besides the scent, I did not like the applicator of the liner.  The tip is on the thicker side and the liner is kind of thick as well.  I wasn't able to get a totally smooth line.  The lashes gripped fine to the liner however.  If you have to remove the lashes to reposition, you will likely need another coat of liner to maintain the hold.  If the liner was unscented and had a better applicator, I would have rated higher.  As is, it's a no from me based on the liner alone.

The hair as lost all the curl pattern. The hair now feels rough and sheds a lot. Don’t buy this hair as you’ll be very dissatisfied.

I ordered three bundles and a closure. The knots in the closure was big. I also tried to bleach the knots and they didn’t take. The lace it isn’t a good quality and I wouldn’t recommend it.

My stylist was using a flat iron, the hair was burning which indicates that’s it’s not 100% human hair like stated.

The length wasn’t to my liking. I had the longest installed first in the back to give some layers and it was whispy and looked thin. I had to cut it.

I wouldn’t buy this hair again.

title: Love it for my gym/pool bag.
text:
Although my favorite product is the coconut melt, this is what I carry in my swim bag when I'm at the pool. It helps to keep my skin feeling good after being in the chlorine 5-6X a week. I only wish that it had the same pure coconut smell as the melt. It travels so much better and gets just a bit thinner while its in my bag so its perfect to rub on after a shower, and I put the excess on the ends of my hair to prevent damage. My curls look so much better. I only wish that it came in a bigger size because one tube lasts about a month for me.

In all honesty, I started using this brand after getting psoriasis of the scalp. Everything seems to aggravate it, but somehow it has stayed pretty controlled with the combination of the chlorine in the water, this, and living proof shampoo. Not a cure, but after trying what seems like everything, it's working for me...at least for now.

Ok I've had luck with a couple mud masks on here and one of those I really liked but,... I can only use the one I really loved every couple of months because it has peel like ingredients and that's not the type of mask to use weekly or bi weekly . This type of mask could be used at least weekly without harsh affects. I was definitely skeptical about the smaller pores claim but it's true !!!! I had my daughter do a video on her iPod and even though it wasn't really noticeable in the mirror afterwards to me at least, on the video the larger pores I have were actually smaller. I cannot figure out how to upload a video from anything other then my iPad so later this week I'm going to get a video or pictures on my iPad so I can post the difference. It's crazy how a mud can do this much without me noticing any major intenseness that I get from my other favorite mud mask, so pretty much I'm getting results without the burning, oh and this is also WAY more then what I get in the jar of my other stuff. So a. It's more, b. It's more affordable, c. It's easier on my skin and yeah you get the picture,. This is definitely the best mud mask you can get for the money and it really shrinks your pores, or my pores at least. My combination skin feels good and "normal" for two to three days after. Now that might not be a lot to you, but for me it's a miracle because usually by day two I'm oily on my problem areas and that's not fun. title: Helpful hand lotion
text: This product is surprisingly thin and absorbs quickly into skin. My hands are prone to splitting and dry skin areas thanks to poor sloughing off of dead skin cells courtesy of a genetic skin condition.  I also spend a lot of time with my hands in water or washing my hands all day and my knockles always crack, especially in the winter and/or if I have used many liquid hand soaps. This crack repair "lotion" does make a difference quickly if you use at least  2x a day. If I missed an application, I could tell since the fingers started to split again. The formula stung slightly on some or the deeper cuts on my hands, but it wasn't too bad. I put this product on  first and then put on my regular hand lotion. My only dislike is the smell of this product. It doesn't smell gross, but doesn't smell pleasant either. It absorb so quickly that I sometimes have to apply a double dose lately with dry heat running in the house.  The small size tube is easy to stash in a purse, pocket or desk drawer.

title: Be careful not to judge too soon.
text: I purchased the Philips Norelco 9160XL with hesitation because I have always used a foil shaver or razor.  Initial impression of the 9160XL was about the same as other users.  I liked the quietness but was not sold on the shave.  After using the shaver for a month, I am now really quite happy with most features the shaver offers.  It is quiet, shaves fairly close (probably comparable to the foil shaver), good battery life, easily cleaned with warm water, trimmer works well, and it seems more gentle than my foil shaver.  The skin on my neck seems to get nicks easily and the 9160, with some practice, nearly solves that problem.  The only MAJOR negative side is that the shaver cannot be left plugged into the charging stand or the cord plugged into the razor without damage to the battery.  I do not like the idea of closely monitoring when the charge is complete.

title: Perfect for my curly hair!
text:
A silk pillowcase isn't enough when you live in a dry climate with curly hair that is prone to frizz. It's exposed to the elements, with minimal protection. Regardless of the product you use, there are still a million other things a woman must contend with such as hormones, aging, etc., that don't help. I notice a huge difference with my hair when sleeping with a satin cap.

I definitely recommend for medium-thick, mid-length hair. After trying several caps, this is the best quality thus far. I love the size, and after several washes, the material is intact, and the caps still feel silky. I wash these in either the hand wash or delicate cycle in cold water in my machine. Hang dry.

What I don't like:
- The band of the cap around my head is slightly large, so wearing it as it doesn't work for me.
- I sleep with a sleep mask. The mask will press the lining of the band against my forehead, creating a god awful line that will last a good majority of the day.

Solution:
- Roll up the band once or twice. This prevents lines from forming on my forehead, and the cap stays in place much better.

title: a competent set but not luxurious
text:
Lately there has been a rush of products that want to use the word "luxury" in their title but are not luxury items by consumer standards. This item falls in that category.

All of the tools included are good tools that are well made. You could even describe them as "above average". They don't have any special features, like "soft touch finish" and the nail clippers don't have the side shields that trap the nail clippings and keep them from flying out. But they are well made and do what they are designed to do.

the case, which is described as a "luxurious" case, is ironically the least impressive item in the set. Its certainly not luxury, unless by luxury you mean "bling-y". And it certainly is overloaded with bling. Like anything that is overly shiny it comes off as "gaudy", although, it will be easy to find in your bag when you are traveling. ha ha. The lack of luxury is not limited to the overly shiny appearance, its also not very nice as far as material selection or build design. A nicer case would suit these tools much better.

That being said, I'm still giving it 4 stars, because at the current price of $10, nobody is thinking that it is luxury anyway. As long as you know what you are getting you can be very happy with the set for $10. Its a good value for quality tools.

title: About this book ...
text:
The first edition of The Presence came out in 1945 and went through two printings. Berthold von Schenk had by then been a LCMS parish pastor for 27 years and was serving his third parish, Our Saviour Lutheran Church in the Bronx, New York. The material came from years of sermons, lectures and retreat meditations. The Presence is his confession of what the Holy Eucharist means to him and what it can mean for us: the actual presence and self-giving of the living Christ.

The 65 years since its original publication have not diminished the power of The Presence to illuminate the well-known narratives and doctrines of our faith in striking ways. It would be a rare pastor or layperson who reads it through without recognizing thereafter holy ground not seen before in worship and life, and without an ever-deepening love for Holy Communion.
This edition is an updated printing of von Schenk's original 1945 edition. Footnotes and an introduction are provided by The Rev. Paul Robert Sauer, current pastor of Our Saviour Lutheran Church in the Bronx, New York.

I really love this headpiece and will definitely use it for more creative photoshoots and for my own costume.

title: Great for the price and low burn risk
text: For the price this does the job. It is slightly deceiving as there are no bristles like a typical brush. Your hair has to be completely brushed before using and I suspect if you have anymore texture to your hair than mine it may pull a bit. I have naturally wavy/curly hair that gets frizzy when brushed so it pulled a bit. The smaller pieces I did the less that happened. However, time is valuable to me so I would prefer it didn’t do that. Not having bristles does allow for a protective shield over the heating element which to me seemed to make it very unlikely to burn you. I didn’t feel the heat once and didn’t use the glove. The entire unit also didn’t get hot like most flat irons which was nice, I didn’t find myself sweating and defeating the purpose of straightening my hair. There was a faint plastic smell when it first turned on but wore off rather quickly.

title: By far best product out there. 14 years experience with colors.
text:
This is they dye to buy! I have been coloring my hair crazy colors on and off for 14 years now and I've tried absolutely every brand. I have naturally dark hair and bleach it but don't like to bleach it white as it damages it so bad it starts falling out. With this brand, I only need to get it to an orangey yellow and every color I have used looks great. I have mostly stuck with purples, blues, reds, and pinks. I just got the atomic pink for the first time thinking it wouldn't be all that great on the orange bleach job and boy was I impressed!
One thing I have learned from my experience is that the first time dying after bleaching isn't as good. It seems to always fade kind of fast expecially towards the scalp. However, a week or two later when I touch it up it seems to last forever after that. Even when it fades it does so with pretty colors.
This dye does stain everything, but I have a travertine shower floor (very porous stone) and have stained just about everything. Spraying bleach on it does the trick!
One more word of advice before I go, the directions say to leave on hair for 20 minutes or so but I just leave it on overnight (make sure to cover your pillowcases or use something you don't mind being stained) and also use a crummy towel for a day or two after you shower. People complain about it staining but that's the point- it is supposed to stick!

title: Love these paper sheet masks, but pricier than others
text:
These are pricier than other compressed facial masks, but they have the advantage of prime shipping (as opposed to 2-3 weeks for international shipping) and of being individually wrapped. I wanted to try making my own masks asap, and also want to take these when I travel and to throw in beauty gifts (spa in a jar) for friends and family. So the fast shipping and individually wrapped masks were worth paying more for me.

I love the concept of soaking these in whatever you like, or placing over a mud mask so that my skin can soak up the benefits and detoxify without drying out too fast. However, these are a bit too small for me width-wise and definitely too small for my hubby (who is willing to sheet mask with me!). I'll probably buy these again just because I can easily travel with them and use in gifts, but I am going to look for larger ones that I can use on a more regular basis. And once you see the difference sheet masking can do for your skin, you might just look forward to using these as often as you can! I know I do!

title: I bought this why...?
text:
The only reason this razor works--and the only reason I rated it with even 3 stars--is because it's a Venus razor. Venus razors work excellently, so when this new version came out I was excited to try it. I've owned mine for over a year now, and was unimpressed with it from the moment I started using it.

The vibrations are useless; I get the same quality shave whether it's turned on or off. The battery lasted quite a long time, but as soon as I replaced it the razor stopped working properly (not that it mattered, since it didn't do anything in the first place). So not only do we have a "power" razor that has no power, but the company decided to charge even more for replacement razor cartridges. I thought I had to use the corresponding cartridges, but finally I inserted one of the old Venus cartridge heads and it worked exactly the same.

I don't know--maybe I'm just a no-fuss girl who really doesn't notice subtle differences in the quality of leg-shaving. I would recommend Venus brand razors in a heartbeat, but I do NOT recommend this particular version.

text:
MWF is amazing stuff. Very few shave soaps leave your skin feeling like 'the fat'. Some have had issues with lathering this soap in some types of water. My water is rated with hardness of 1.8 - 7.6 grains per gallon. I have no trouble lathering this soap but if your water is significantly harder, you may have different results.

The fragrance of this soap is very mild and neutral. The scent is noticeable in the lather but does not persist post shave.

MWF will be a permanent part of my shave den and I think if anyone sticks with traditional wet shaving for long enough they will end up with a puck eventually.

title: I'll never go without it again!
text:
I'm a bigger girl, size 42DD for reference. I've started walking at least 2.5 miles a day wearing a weighted vest. Even in cool weather, with all the hills in my neighborhood, I end up drenched in sweat.

And that means, of course, boob sweat. I have ruined multiple bras and the smell is so gross. Since adding the vest, it's gotten so much worse. It's absolutely disgusting until I get a chance to shower. But I'm a busy mom of two special needs kids, so there are days I get back and can't shower right away, so then I'm feeling gross until I can.

I finally had enough and started looking for a solution. I found this stuff and figured I'd give it a shot. I was realistic in my expectations that it would help a bit, maybe even just help the smell, since is a strenuous activity and not a stroll through a grocery store. I wasn't expecting it to keep me from sweating at all or anything.

I tried it out for the first time today and it blew my expectations out of the water! I was slightly damp, but not even enough to drip. No smell. My bra was almost completely dry! And it's lasted ALL DAY.

I'm one of those ladies who hate wearing a bra at home, but hate how the girls rub without fabric there. I usually tuck whatever shirt I'm wearing under there. But that means that if I end up sweating for some reason, my shirt ends up wet and gross. Today, I realized that after taking off my bra, I wasn't bothered by the skin on skin. The lotion leaves a silky softness on the skin and it kept me comfortable all day.

Now on to the description. The bottle is smaller than I expected, but I learned that a little goes a long way. The lotion goes on creamy and dries quickly. It left no residue on my clothing or any I could see on my skin, except for on my hand from where I applied it. It rinsed off easily. The smell is supposed to be lily, according to the bottle, and I guess it kinda does smell like lily, though the product description listed apple in one place, so I dunno. But it's not a strong scent and it completely disappeared after application.

I love this product. I'm going to be a habitual user from now on and I'm recommending it to all my lady friends!

title: Best I've tried (and an apology)
text:
I'm sorry folks - every time I decide I have a favorite hair care product, whether shampoo, conditioner, or a styling product, the manufacturer discontinues it within a year. And because I discovered I like this stuff last year, it has apparently been discontinued. It was about $4 previously, and easily available form Walmart and Amazon. Prices have tripled online, and Walmart no longer stocks it.

That's too bad, because this stuff is close to perfect. I like the hold - it lasts, without being stiff or sticky, the easy application, and the fact that it leaves you with a natural matte finish and doesn't look slick or greasy. At $4 it was an incredible value, but now you might be able to find something better. I don't know what try next, because I've never been a fan of paying $10-$15 for higher-end brands (didn't like the ones I tried), and I'm not counting on this being available here as what is becoming old stock. There are other Got2B products in similar jars but they are nothing like this clay.

text:

Such a shame, you'd think with such a easy job they'd be able to do it properly.

I'll be resoldering this myself, but the majority of people buying this won't be able to do this.

It seems that with psoriasis, what works for one person may not for others. This product works well for me. Here's something you can do that will save you quite a bit of money:
instead of paying up to $35 per tube of coal tar cream, get some aloe gel that doesn't have any perfumes in it or other stuff like that. Use that and some Balnetar to make a cream. The cream you'll make is the same or better than what you would pay $35 per tube for. On top of that, you could probably make 10-12 batches of the cream from one bottle of Balnetar. You can see the amount of savings.

title: It's worth trying
text:
This is an interesting way to get some very nice curls in your hair. It’s a long soft rod type thing. The material is the usual you’d get for a curler wrapped in silk. It’s all bendy and what you do is sort of braid your hair onto/with this. After that, you use the included scrunchies to hold it in place at the bottom.

title: Meh...
text:
This is an okay eye mask...

First, I’m not sure if the size or shape is off. It kind of poked me in my inner corner. If I put it any lower so it wouldn’t do that, it left way too much of my under eye uncovered.

I like that it has sticking on the back, because most gel under eye masks slide off easily. However, these didn’t stick well at all. As you can see I’m the last photo, it lifts up and that was taken right after I applied it. Every time I tried sticking it back down, it would just lift back up again.

Finally, it wasn’t hydrating at all. When I applied them, there didn’t seem like there was much substance on them at all. I didn’t think too much about that though, because I’d used masks like that before that were still very good. However, after leaving these on for the recommended time, I didn’t notice any difference and my under eyes didn’t feel any more hydrated than before. A moisturizer would be better, and I wouldn’t have to wait around with it sitting on my under eyes to do that.

Overall, it’s okay. It definitely isn’t great. Unfortunately, I definitely don’t recommend it at $6 (at time of writing this) for 1 pack that only includes 1 set of under eye masks. There’s much better options, especially ones you get more than 1 set and for less money.

The Dr shaved the callous and recommended surgery and in the mean time gave me some Dr Jills Gel Tubes to protect my toe. The are very soft gel that you cut to length and slip over the toe. Well its been over a year since the Drs recommendation and I have worn the tube every time I have shoes on. No reoccurrence of the calluses, no pain, perfect. The tube can be reused over and over. One box contains a couple of tubes that in my case provide 6-8 lengths to protect my small toe.

text: the first time i attempted to use this glue it would not stick at all, so a few days ago i attempted to use it again because i seen it said it has a 5-6 sec drying time. i let it dry for a few seconds and attempted to put on my lashes, omg y’all i stuck it on there for a few seconds i was holding it with my tweezers to make sure it was stuck, IT STILL WASNT DRY AND LITERALLY FELL RIGHT IN MY EYE!!!! it was the most painful experience i’ve ever had with my eye, it burned sooooo bad so i washed it water and it still was hurting so bad & it felt like maybe a eyelash went into my eye so i went to patient first & they said my cornea was scratched, i did notice right when it happened and i washed my eye out with water that i could barely look at any light, so a scratched cornea made sense, basically i wouldn’t recommend this glue at all i’m sticking to my kiss individual lash glue, it lasts about a week but i’ve never had any problems with it falling into my eye because it was still not dry. maybe one day i will try this glue again and be very very careful but idk it will be awhile.

text:
I will update after a few more wears, but so far, so good.
I cut it, did a curl set and steamed the curls with a clothing steamer to set and brushed out.
The shade of blonde is very pretty, it is sort of a lightest ash blonde, not entirely platinum but not as yellow as a #613.
It has dimension and just the right amount of shine.
Super soft.
It will obviously tangle, being so long and synthetic, but so far I wore it for a day and night and it brushed out just fine. The ear flaps go down too far on the sides for me, but I have a tiny head.
Good value for money!

title: Mediocre for me, but YMMV
text:
I tested these under a number of use cases and noted how long the blades remained effective (clean shave, non-nicking) for:
[benchmark: 4-5 good shaves per edge with Astra Platinum]
Dry shave (2/edge)
Dry shave after a hot towel (2-3/edge)
Wet shave - soap (2-3/edge)
Wet shave - cream (3/edge)
I personally prefer to dry shave after a hot towel in the interest of minimizing hassle on frequent camping trips. Worth noting, I have a medium-coarse beard and sensitive skin, so I prefer very sharp blades rather than medium-sharp like these. I'm not really impressed with the polymer coating - it doesn't glide as well as blades using other finish coats (and notes on the blade that you're not to wipe dry - likely as it'll only accelerate roughening the polymer coat to to the skip-and-nick stage).

Sadly, it only took me one pack of blades to determine these aren't for me. The second pack I'll relegate to emergency spares, for when some shave is better than none.

title: love this product
text: This is my first review, ever. I have used this Aloe for the past year and I was going to reorder it again for the forth time, when I noticed the lack of good reviews for the product, this made me feel bad because I just love it. First time I bought it because I had some irritation around my eyes and I wanted to buy something without alcohol so it does not get irritated more. I started using it around the eyes then my whole face. I love how my skin looks in the morning, very clear  and glowing. I had some sun damage on my forehead and all of a sudden it started fading then it disappeared completely. I started putting it on my forearms and hands and it also helped with the sun damage that you get on the arms from driving. Now I use it on my chest, full face and forearms and my skin looks amazing. I only put it at night in place of a night cream, it is a little sticky for a minute but it is absorbed very quickly. By the time I finish putting it on my face it has already dried on my chest and forearms. You have to be persistent and apply it every night and you have to be patient. It seems that the time it takes to fade the discoloration has to do with how bad the skin is damaged. I had areas that cleared faster then others. Also it seems that some areas might look worse before they get better. It will look darker then as if a little more visible before it completely disappear. I have sent this to my sister overseas and she also loves it. You do not need to use a lot, it spreads very nicely. I recommend this product for anyone who has sun damage and discoloration on the skin, just be patient and consistent.

title: Super easy to use and interesting design!
text:
I've wanted a good tool that could both straighten and curl my hair and this one is the perfect one for the job (and it was a bonus that it's a great price too)

I'm pretty inexperienced with styling my hair and couldn't be bothered to curl my hair in the mornings with a rod curler that I had purchased before, but this one just makes it sooo much faster in the mornings. Just clamp down on a section, twist 180 degrees, and run it through - even a newbie like me could do this and get super cute loose waves :)

The power button is located on the inside , which is nice so that you won't accidentally turn on the iron by accident as long as it's in the closed/locked position when not in use. Also the temperature control is super interesting because you twist the bottom portion to the right or left to increase or decrease the temperature - so even less buttons to accidentally press while using it 👌

Overall, I definitely recommend it!

title: Very good, but the pro-health is better
text:
I've been brushing my teeth wih oral-b for over 10 years now, and they are all similar to the vitality model. I've always used the least expensive model since I see no difference from the expensive ones, unless you are looking for "extras", like timer, lcd screen, etc. The vitality is a very good brush. I use the round head instead of the elongated. I rather brush my teeth with oral-b than any other eletric brush on the market. The sonic kind hurts my gum and it tickles a lot as well. Oral-B, and their entry level eletric brushes are the way to go. I can't brush my teeth with regular toothbrush anymore. Brush heads are cheaper on ebay but I found out they don't last as long as those you buy at grocery stores around $20 for 3. I buy the precision clean brush in bulk on ebay for around $1 each. They last a good 2 months. The ones at walmart/amazon and such last 3 months or more. The bad thing about the vitality rechargeable and all the older oral-b I own is that you need to recharge it after 3-4 days of 2-3 daily brushings. I think this is annoying. I didn't want to leave the brush recharging after every use. So I bought the ORAL-B Pro-Health that uses two AA batteries. It is simply AMAZING. The quality is the same as the rechargeables, but it is even better. The batteries lasts forever on the pro-health. I put 2 rechargeable AA (2000 MA) and the thing kept going and going without a noticeable lack of power for a good 2 months. It is the best. The vitality rechargeable brush gets very slow after 3-4 days. Not with the pro-health. Buy the pro-health. It is the way to go if you like this kind of ORAL-B design. Another thing is ORAL-B equipment lasts forever. I only have one eletric brush where the original rechargeable battery died on me. And since they are the entry level brushes, I just buy another one of the same. No need to buy another battery.
Again, go with the ORAL-B PRO-HEALTH eletric toothbrush.

title: This is the real deal!
text:
Everything stated in the description is true. Though it's not a cure, it sure does help. I have been using Clobetasol cream via RX to help clear up the outbreaks of Psoriasis (it's a cream that is rubbed on the effected area and helps heal psoriasis lesions that pop up on the skin); but the problem is you have to keep the affected area covered all the time; in my case it's mainly my hands; YOU TRY WEARING PLASTIC GLOVES 24/7! So I give myself a break with this lotion.
This lotion definitely keeps my hands moist and I have less outbreaks. I still use gloves to help hold in the moisture a bit more, but not all the time. Moisture is what psoriasis needs to help heal this condition. This lotion helps with that. Will most certainly will reorder again.
My hat's off to Fay Farms. Remember, skin conditions like Psoriasis, Eczema, etc. are auto-immune diseases. They are incurable. Think twice before taking prescription medications; they do NOT cure, are loaded with many unpleasant side effects, some even lethal; their outrageously priced, etc. Unfortunately, just because you're healing doesn't mean you're cured. Breakouts come and go. You never know when, but I notice I get them more often when I'm ultra-stressed. I have had this condition for many, many years. Took me until now to find the right product.

Hope this review helped.

text:
This Hydro-Plumping Hyaluronic Acid Serum is a simple, yet a powerhouse serum. It has wonderful moisturizing, anti-aging, antioxidant, and calming ingredients that are top notch. There are several types of super moisturizing Hyaluronic Acid. It also has Green Tea, which is proven to be an excellent antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial superstar.
This is a wonderful serum to use during your day or night routine. I like to apply it to damp, or well hydrated skin. Usually after applying a few layers of my toner. It applies and absorbs easily, and a little does go a long way. Any slight tackiness is taken care of after applying a good moisturizer to help lock in all the good stuff. It has a very light, hardly noticeable scent.
It really hydrates my skin and plumps my fine lines and wrinkles. My skin looks and feels better when using it. I have combination skin, but use Retin-A, which can be a bit drying and sometimes irritating. This serum really calms the irritation, yet enhances the anti-aging effects of the Retin-A.
This serum is a great every day serum. Especially for those who have sensitive and/or dry skin, but is beneficial for any skin type. It has great ingredients, and is not loaded with harsh chemicals, and provides so much good stuff for your skin. It is a simple, yet powerful serum. Highly recommended.

The stars of this serum are:

~Antioxidant: Sodium Hyaluronate Crosspolymer, Camellia Sinensis Leaf Extract, Tocopheryl Acetate
~Skin-identical ingredient: Sodium Hyaluronate Crosspolymer, Sodium Hyaluronate, Hyaluronic Acid, Glycerin
~Soothing: Camellia Sinensis Leaf Extract, Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Extract

Simple, yet super ingredients!

~Buffering: Sodium Hydroxide
~Chelating: Sodium Phytate
~Emollient: Lecithin, Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Extract
~Emulsifying: Lecithin

title: Of course a good blow drier and flat iron are essential
text: I'm going to give the Etae line 4 stars. I can achieve a blow out using other products that are just as effective. They key to having straight hair, if you're not using Etae, is to shampoo once with a clarifying shampoo, then use a shampoo and conditioner that reviitize the hair. Use a heat protectant, leave-in conditioner to add moisture, blow dry and flat iron. Of course a good blow drier and flat iron are essential, as they save you time and less stress on the hair. Now, back to Etae. When I originally used this product, I thought it was a waste of money as my hair didn't look any different than my normal thermal straightening routine, plus it took more time with the extra step of letting the caramel sit for 20-30 minutes.  However, since I invested in the product, I am going to use it. It was 2 months or so before I used the product again. This time, I let the caramel sit on my hair for an hour while I cleaned around the house. Oh, and prior to the caramel, I did a pre-conditioning treatment to detangle my hair from a rod set. My hair felt different after rinsing the caramel. It was softer than I remembered from the 1st use. I applied heat protect spray and leave-in conditioner sparingly. At the end of the process, my hair felt soft and easy to blow dry and flat iron. Could it be the pre-Condish treatment? Because I modified the steps, I can't say 100% that Etae is 5 stars. Plus, I had a routine already. But, if you are new to thermal straightening I would give it a try.

title: A generous, potent bottle of lavender essential oil.
text:
This is my first foray into essential oils and I'm liking it a lot. I'm using the oil in two ways: for aroma and, in theory, for its physiological properties. I like diffusers a lot but am too cheap and suspicious of additives to buy them often. I've been using this lavender oil along with some safflower oil and rubbing alcohol in my bedroom and it adds a nice, luxurious touch to bedtime. I've sprinkled a bit on my body pillow, too, when I feel like I want a much stronger dose of the relaxation.

I read somewhere that mixing it with a carrier oil (I'm using rosehip oil) and rubbing it on the bottom of your feet can help with insomnia, so I've been doing that. I don't know if it's working, but it is making my feet feel softer, so that's something. I haven't experienced any respiratory or skin irritation with this product.

The bottle is a dark brown color so that the light can't get to the oil and break it down. They sent a dropper along with the oil, which I appreciated since I didn't have others. Next I'm going to try to make some kind of reusable sachet for my drawers--I just need to figure out what scent to mix it with first.

I was fortunate to receive this product at a free or discounted rate in exchange for my honest review. title: If you are pregnant, you will love this!
text:
When I received the product it had begun to leak very slightly in the packaging and the security seal on the cap had almost completely come off(from it leaking) which is the only negative thing I have to say about this product.

The smell is so subtle and pleasant. It's does not have the harsh chemical smell of other nail polish removing products. You really have to sniff at the bottle to even smell it to begin with, but it is a very pleasant earthy mint smell. I would compare it to a very muted Camphor.

I first tried it on one hand and used regular acetone based nail polish remover to remove the polish off my other hand. There is an incredible difference. This product left my nails feeling stronger and my cuticles and fingers feeling moisturized.

I would absolutely recommend this to everyone especially pregnant women who may be sensitive to chemical/strong smells. It's all natural and it works fantastic. I am so glad I gave this a shot! The process works a little different than what I was used to but it is really easy and simple.

title: Not bad for a cheaper face and cellulite messager
text:
I didn't think the unit was working, it has vague instructions, but just touch it to dry bare skin and you'll feel it. I did not come wit a AC plug, (minus one star for that), you'll have to use one from another gadget, I used my tablet one. When it is charged, press and hold the button in until it beeps and lights up. There are two levels of power, I think, press the button one more time, the indicator light on the power button is orange, press it one more time and you'll see red. It runs for 3 minutes and then shuts off. You can use it a total of 30 minutes in one day. Diagrams in the booklet show you which way to use it effectively. This is important- you need to use a hydro gel or a oil, like rose hip oil or such like I do or you will feel a slight electric shock against your skin.
Have I seen improvements? YES. I had a NUface facial and this gadget seems to being doing as well as the NUface mini. I use it every day and I notice tighter skin, less redness, and less wrinkles. I use it just 3 minutes every morning. For the price I think it is a nice portable massage. I use it also with my cellulite cream on my legs and without changing anything else, the cellulite is fading (been only a week).

title: Worked Great
text:
I read a lot of the reviews on this item before buying it. I've looked at several other Henna hair dyes, and this one is certainly the best bang for your buck. Others I've looked at retail for $36 and are much more complicated to use than this one.
I followed the instructions exactly and found it was such and easy process. Washed my hair twice with a clarifying shampoo, towel dried my hair, mixed the henna powder with warm water and applied. Although it said to leave the product on for 1 hour, I left mine on for 2 since I have blonde roots. Surprisingly, it covered my roots great and I have consistant color all over.
The smell might be off-putting to some users, although I regularly use a henna based shampoo, so I am used the the grassy/dirt odor it has. I follow up with a mixture of 4 parts water, 1 part apple cider vinegar, and a few drops of lavendar EO, which leaves hair shiny, conditioned, and smelling great!
Overall, I would recommend this product to anyone and will continue to use it myself instead of chemical based hair dyes.

text:
My finance owns the same toothbrush in the rechargeable model, but I opted for this battery-operated unit. The brushes are, I believe, different, so consider that if you're buying a second Sonicare for travel.

I read the reviews here on Amazon and as a result I applied a little petroleum jelly to the rubber seal on the door of the battery compartment. When I use the toothbrush I lay it on its side afterward or flick the brush several times with my finger before setting it upright. It's been some years now and it works perfectly. Batteries last a long time and are inexpensive to replace. The toothbrush keeps my teeth really clean.

title: A good human hair wig!
text:
613-20”-bangs

I would buy this again! It came in a bag, tangle free and had a slight smell to it. Bangs are long enough to be cut to desired length. In both pictures they are uncut.

The first picture is it straight out of the bag, only styling the bangs with a flat iron. The second picture is after a color bath and styling.

THE ENDS TAKE COLOR QUICKLY! I dipped mine in a purple shampoo bath, leaving the ends out (only allowing the water to touch it when squeezing the water out) and they still took more color than the top of the wig, along with the bangs. Holds styling well, went all day without losing curls even in the snow.

I would say it’s all human hair, I don’t see any plastic hairs or had any melting when styling.

The wig is 20” from top to bottom, though I was expecting the hair to be 20”. It’s a comfortable stretchy mesh cap, and fits my larger head snuggly. My head is about 23” around, so heads 22”-24” should be fine wearing this.

title: No need to keep looking - this is the beard oil/conditioner you need
text:
I'm on my third bottle of this beard oil and I'm very happy with it. I like to grow full bore mountain man beards, especially during ski season, and this stuff keeps my beard feeling soft, controls stray hairs, and even gives it a richer, fuller color than when it's dry. No joke - some random guy in the car next to me at a stop light yesterday motioned to where his beard would be, pointed at me, and gave me a thumbs up. I think Flapwings deserves some of the credit for that.

Also, why is it that 90% of my beard compliments are from other guys? Can't blame Flapwings for that but it’s a thing. I've had at least three people yell "nice beard!" or some variation of that while driving past. Am I being cat called? Is this sexual harassment? I don't know the answers but if you want a beard that compels strangers to yell compliments at you then give this stuff a try.

title: Great primer!
text:
This is a really great primer! I have used many over the years and this is one of the top preforming primers I have ever used. It does it's job just as well as way more expensive brands.

It is for sure comparable to Smashbox Photo Ready Primer. The texture is very very similar, and it goes on just as smooth as that brand.

I use it after my morning facial routine of cleansing, serums, toning and moisturizer. I squeeze about two pumps worth onto my hands and apply it all over my face. I concentrate on areas that need filling in, like around my eyes and mouth where I have fine lines. Then let it settle for about 5 minutes and apply my normal makeup routine. My foundation glides right over it and doesn't settle in to any of my fine lines or wrinkles.

Overall this is a solid choice for a good primer. It fills in where I need it to and lasts all day. I highly recommend!

They come in 6 flavors & I like all of them.

title: Proven ingredients, but a poor value
text:
I’m not all that impressed with these products. Neither container lists the ingredients on the label, instead providing the ingredient list on a card that’s in the box. It shows that the cleaner is a 2% salicylic acid wash, which is a pretty tried and true formulation for treating acne. It is a low-lather, but still effective cleaner, but I didn’t experience any difference with this compared with other 2% salicylic cleaners that cost far less. It’s a fine cleaner, but way overpriced for such a tiny (0.51 oz) container.

The repairing night cream is a combination of retinol (0.05%), niacinamide (3%), and hyaluronic acid (2%). All are proven performers, but again, it’s quite overpriced considering how low of a percentage of retinol is in the formulation. It does a decent job of moisturizing and did not cause any skin irritation. I am a fan of retinol, but the concentration in this cream (0.05%) is well below what I usually use (either 0.1% or 0.5%).

While this product combo is on the right track, the value is just not there considering the amount in the container (one-half an ounce for each). While I would certainly recommend a salicylic acid wash and a retinol-based cream, there are many other options that provide these options at a far lower cost. Four stars for performance; 1 star for value; overall rating of 2.5 stars.

title: Not useful for the international traveller
text: Described as 'ideal for travel' with it's multi-voltage design, but it is totally useless for this purpose. The electrical plug is a standard US one with a polarized large neutral pin that will happily plug into a US wall socket, but won't plug into any country adapter I've found. We tried 4 different types of adapter for Australia/NZ and UK and none of then would work even though 2 had the facility for the correct polarized pin design. Also, as others have pointed out the lever for the opening mechanism is cheap plastic that flexes badly against the power of a spring. This looks like it will last maybe a couple of uses before snapping off - if you can find somewhere to plug it in!

title: Does a great job in comparison to soaking off.
text:
I hate the soaking process. My hands end up freezing and I just don't have the patience to sit for as long as it takes to soak my gel polish off. So then I end up using a file to remove it - it works but it is very time consuming and at least my hands are "doing" something. Plus, sometimes I go a little overboard and end up with thinning out my actual nail. Oops! And owie!

This is where Gel Nail Polish Remover comes in. Before buying this product I read many, many reviews on various similar products as well as this one. The "worst" reviews I saw complained of this product causing nails to curl. As it so happens, exactly as I thought, the cause of nails curling from this product is THIN NAILS. I had previously gone a little rough on one of my pinky nails, thinning it out to the point that putting pressure on the nail hurt. Of course, that nail curled up when I applied this product. My other nails, all still mostly standard thickness, were fine. Also, it is very important to note that the nail does relax back to normal shape after removal. At least, mine did.

I had also read in another review the suggestion to apply one coat, leave on for 5 or 6 minutes then apply another coat. I can concur that this is the best practice. It is also important to remember to user your nail file to rough up/remove the top coat. If you forget that step, it won't do a darned thing!

I have now used this product no less than 3 times, on both my hands and feet, and can say that the nail curling only happened on the first application. It has not happened again with additional polish removal sessions. Again, it is important to not skip the filing off of the top layer and to apply multiple times, allowing ample time for the product to work between applications.

I absolutely recommend this product just so long as you fully understand the limitations and HOW to use it. Great value for the price, too!

I would recommend this toothbrush to anyone looking for a better toothbrush that wants a cleaner mouth and whiter teeth.

title: Burning, stinging, not suitable for children.
text:
Bought this for our toddlers. Initially was turned off by the smell, very strong rubbing alcohol scent probably from whatever is in it to make it a clear gel. That wasn’t the greatest but isn’t the main reason for the 1 Star.

The reasons this gets a 1 Star is:

- all three of our girls complained that the sunscreen was stinging everywhere it was applied. They don’t complain with other brands so this was definitely unusual.

- after it was applied and dried, the sunscreen left a film on all of our three girls skin. In addition some of the sunscreen started peeling off in little balls that felt rubbery.

Because of these issues we won’t be using it again.

title: Looks great, mediocre shave
text:
This was kind of a last ditch effort to find a more comfortable shaving experience. I've tried several electrics with the hope of finding a more comfortable shave since I have sensative skin and am prone to razor burn. At the end of the day, I've found frequently replacing the Mach3 blades is the best I can do. It gauls me to keep spending on money on something I have to toss, but it's better than the alternatives to date.

The Norelco Architec 1090 looks great and shaves better on the neck than the foil shavers I've tried including the Panasonic Nano and Braun Activator. However, it still misses a critical area in the middle cheek just along where a goatee would start to back about 1.5 inches from there. The hair in that part of my face tends to lay down. The Braun seemed to get that area OK, but did not do well in the neck area.

When I push harder to get those hard to get whiskers, I end up with road rash and sporadic ingrown whiskers. This and other electric razors may work with people who have different types of beards or face shapes, but I've yet to find an electric that works for my whole beard.

In my opinion, a $250 razor ought to do the job quite comfortably. I think there are better ways to use the funds, like on three years worth of blades and shaving cream.

title: Eye Replacement Head Fits Glo Pro Perfectly & Makes It Easier To Use Glo Pro In Eye Area
text:
I’m using the Glo Pro eye attachment head with my Glo Pro that I bought from a department store that included only the face attachment head. The eye head is slimmer and less than half the width with just four rows of needles. The eye head is an authentic and high quality attachment that snaps on easily and fits Glo Pro perfectly. I definitely prefer using this slimmer eye head for the delicate area around my eyes and between my brows and even my forehead (which is small). The smaller head gives me better control and greater ease of using Glo Pro in small areas.

I wasn’t sure of the boundaries around my eye area, so I emailed Glo Pro and was informed the eye head can be used right up to the bottom lashes (but not on the eye lids). Still, this device is new to me so for now I don’t go much beyond the orbital bone- where I apply my night time eye cream. The Glo Pro needles are short and feel just a little prickly and give me a slight burning sensation. But it’s not uncomfortable or painful and hasn’t caused any excessive redness or irritation. I definitely recommend the smaller eye attachment head for Glo Pro users and rate it 5 stars.

I wasn’t provided a Glo Pro device and this review is only of the eye attachment head. Still, I’m sure people wonder if Glo Pro works. I’ve used a Glo Pro about a month, twice a week, and don’t feel I’ve used it long enough to know. I’m in my 50’s and my skin does happen to look good lately. I don’t see dramatic changes, but my skin seems firmer and my fine lines around my eyes and elsewhere seem less noticeable. But I feel I need to use Glo Pro longer to decide if it’s the device, my skin care products or both that are providing a benefit. I do like Glo Pro enough to keep using it.

Things will start to work, or work for a small time, and then my face will be back to it's oily, cystic self.

Recently I've been using an Aveeno daily exfoliator with an Aveeno moisturizer. It wasn't really doing the trick. I thought, perhaps I need to use toner. Since Aveeno is all natural, I decided to stick with that theme.

I started to get concerned when I began getting small white pimples appearing, but friends told me that was my face getting rid of the junk. I was just thankful they weren't huge cysts! A week later, my skin is almost completely clear. I only have one active pimple on my face that is in the process of healing. I hope that it stays this way!

Also I must say that the smell is divine! My boyfriend even likes it. I wish the bottle would never run out, but I know that when it does, I'm buying another.

• The tip isn’t as precise as what I’m used to using which is why it’ll cause you to mess up a bit.

I like it but I’m not in like with it. I don’t really see myself reaching for this unless it’s all I have on hand.

title: Good soap, good value
text:
First, I have to echo the other reviewer's sentiment about the picture being misleading. The text does state that you're buying a single stick, but the picture makes it look like you're buying a box of 'em.

I was initially disappointed with my [[ASIN:B002A5OLHQ Arko Shaving Soap Stick]]. I prefer using a brush and mug, so I unwrapped the stick, cut it into shaving soap coins (which I believe are legal tender in Venezuela and Costa Rica, and certain counties in Arkansas), put them into my mug and stuck it in the microwave for 30 seconds to melt them. What a mistake! That's what I do with [[ASIN:B001A3DNY6 Van Der Hagen Deluxe Shave Soap, 2.5-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 12)]], and it works great--the soap liquifies, adheres to the bottom and sides of the mug, and once it resolidifies, I'm good to go. This stuff softened, yes, but it didn't really liquify. Instead, it kind of foamed up and over the top of the mug. I tried to use my knife to moosh it back into the mug, but it resulted in a very rough, craggy top surface. Figured I'd just use the brush on it anyway--eventually I would wear down that rough surface and leave behind a smooth top that would work perfectly.

I'm glad I did! This soap lathered up like nobody's business when I put the warm, moist brush to it. It made a little thinner lather than I usually get from VDH, but despite it's thinness, it wasn't runny at all--it stayed right where I brushed it, and didn't dry out before my razor got to it. My habit is to do three shaves in different directions, and the Arko lather held out for all three.

I used an older blade, an [[ASIN:B001QY8QXM 100 Astra Superior Premium Platinum Double Edge Safety Razor Blades]], probably about two shaves past when I would usually have replace it, but I was being lazy. I kind of expected to nick myself a couple times. But with the Arko shaving soap, that did not happen. My blade glided across my face as smoothly as I could ask. No nicks at all.

As many have mentioned, the scent is kind of strong, and not entirely pleasant. Some have compared it to citronella, which I can understand. I though it was kind of a cross between the original Old Spice scent from when my dad used their cologne, and some industrial chemical smell. VDH is more or less unscented, so I usually mix a few drops of my favorite cologne ([[ASIN:B00AATHC52 ASPEN by Coty]]) into the liquid when it comes out of the microwave, but I didn't think that would be a good idea with Arko. I didn't think the cologne scent would mix well with the cloying scent the soap came with. But while the scent isn't my cup of tea, after you rinse your face well, it's not very strong at all, especially if you wash your face afterward and use a scented after-shave balm.

The bottom line is, for a single stick, the value isn't great. It's a lot more affordable, and just as usable a product, as some of the much more expensive soaps out there, but at the single stick price, plus shipping, you could buy several pucks of Van Der Hagen locally. When you buy more sticks at a time, the per-stick price comes down, and if you can manage to get free shipping in the deal, it starts looking really attractive. The lather is very nice, the scent, not so much, but all in all, you can't go too far wrong with it. I'm dinging it one star only because of the scent. While I would rather it liquify in the microwave like VDH, that's not how the product was designed to be used, so it wouldn't be fair to dock it for that.

title: Mattifying
text:
I was interested in trying this night cream because it claims to be especially formulated for oily to normal skin.

PACKAGING:🌟🌟🌟☆☆

The night cream comes in a squeezable tube. I am not a big fan of this type of packaging because as you continue to use it, it becomes harder to get the product out and it can be wasteful. However, this type of packaging is great for traveling. Also, while I am not super impressed with the packaging, it does a nice job at keeping the product fresh.

FIRST IMPRESSION: 🌟🌟🌟🌟☆

It has a light to medium consistency. It has a yellowish color but it does not stain your skin. It has a light scent and it is creamy. It is easy to distribute and apply. It does not irritate or cause redness. While you apply it it has a almost glossy finish and the skin feels soft but as it dries the skin looks matte and it feels smooth. There is no visible residue.

PERFORMANCE:🌟🌟🌟☆☆

After I used it the first time I thought, "Actually this is nice, I think I will really like it", but after using it a few more times, I have changed my opinion. It has great benefits and it excels in some areas but in others I am not very impress with it.

I am impress with the quality and its natural ingredients. It feels really nice when you put it on and the scent is not overbearing which is great. It has no parabens or dangerous chemicals. It is cruelty-free. It does not irritate my skin and it does not cause breakouts. It dries very fast which is great for those long days when I can wait to long to go to bed. It does not have a sticky or greasy finish.

I have been using two different serums and they do not seen to get alone with this cream. So I change it to another and the same problem occur. After my serum is absorb into my skin, I apply this cream but it does not go on smoothly. It looks like brush strokes and it is very patchy. At first, I thought that I was applying to much but the results were the same with less product. This is not a big deal since it will dry either way. But it bother me for some reason.

I enjoy how soft and supple my skin feels as soon as I apply it but then it losses that quality and becomes very matte and it is not longer super soft. My face feels a bit stiff. I would not mind much since it might be helping my skin stay firm. Buw when I wake up in the morning my skin does not feel very moisturize which I do not like. Every time I use it, I want to add a sleeping pack on top for moisture.

However, I have to mentioned that while my skin does not feel supple and hydrated in the morning, it is not greasy or oily either. I am not saying the it will remove all of your sebum/oil but it just makes your skin look matte. I give it points for that but honestly, I rather give my skin hydration at night and I do not care much about looking oily.

OVERALL ASSESSMENT:
Price Point: 🌟🌟🌟🌟☆
Quality/Durability: 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟
Need: 🌟🌟🌟☆☆
Recommendation: 🌟🌟🌟🌟☆

title: Strong hold
text: Prior to this purchase, I tried Eyelure Promagnetic Lash eyeliner w/ lashes.  It was horrible.  Had to apply 3 coats of eyeliner and then the lashes didn't even stick.  With this Amazon purchase, I was amazed at the strong hold.  One coat of eyeliner and the lashes held beautifully... even the ends!!  The only downfall is that you really need to be an expert using liquid eyeliner.  I am not.  So practice makes perfect.  Every time gets better.  When applying, a magnetic 'chunk' will sometimes appear and will throw your line off.  Removal is easy, but not super quick.  Because of the strong hold, I have to gently apply/rub a makeup wipe over the lashes until the product is removed and lashes can be peeled off.  All of the different thicknesses and lengths of lashes given allows for many uses!  For the same price as drug store brands, I get so much more!!  Great purchase, just need more practice!

title: The Negative Reviews Don't Do This Shaver Justice ⚖
text: I will start out by saying that I did not purchase my Wahl Smart Shaver from Amazon since I found it cheaper elsewhere.  With that being said, I'd like to comment based on my usage of this shaver thus far. First of all, I just recently used a Braun 9 series shaver. Unfortunately, this shaver does not have a cleaning/charging station but I'm not convinced that is a deal breaker. I am also puzzeld by some of the negative reviews here. I literally turned on both shavers, and in my honest opinion, the Wahl was slightly quieter. The Wahl does have some similarities to a Remington shaver. For example, the two inner blades resemble the Remington as does the sound of the shaver. The outter foil seems to be very unique to the Wahl brand. So in using the Wahl Smart Shaver, I found it to be very effective on 2+ days of beard growth as it went through the facial hair with ease. The shaver head is thinner which in my opinion allowed me to get closer than both Braun and Remington shavers. The hypoallergenic foils that have symmetrical and asymmetrical foil slots provided me with an exceptionally close and clean shave. Almost 12 hours after my initial shave, and I barely felt any stubble growth. To me that speaks volumes about this shaver. I was very skeptical about trying this shaver based on the prior reviews here and the fact that the Wahl shaver was cheaper than the leading brands (e.g., Braun, Panasonic, Remington, etc..). However, for now I'm glad I took a chance and decided to give the Wahl Smart Shaver a chance. Also, if you view other sites, this shaver ranks significantly higher than it does amongst Amazon shoppers. Not sure why this is but something doesn't make sense to me. So if you want a clean shave and also don't want to go into debt buying a shaver, I suggest giving this shaver a try. By the way I'm retired military and this would've been nice to use while I was active duty. Lastly, if you're still not convinced, please take into account that Wahl guarantees this shaver for five (5) years. Take a chance. You'll be glad you did!

title: Prepare to be Amazed!
text:
I moved from wet blade shaving to electrics 8 years ago now. Shaving against the grain with a blade makes a real mess of my face and shaving only with the grain doesn't give me a brilliant result. I'd figured that technolgy marches on and that electrics would be better than they were when I'd first started shaving and I was right. I was pretty happy with the remington that I bought, but after a year or so I saw a Braun activator 8585 at half price in a local store and as at the time it was close to the top of the range, I bought it. That was a revelation to me. It shaved even better and the cleaning station left it refreshed again and again. 7 years later, the battery isn't holding charge and so I looked again. I was amazed to find 'shaving forums' on the web! You guys are nuts ;) but thanks for all your craziness and for sharing the tales of your hunts for the ultimate shave!

A lot of these shaving enthusiasts were raving about the new Panasonic Arc 4 Nano wet/dry and many thought that the cleaning station version just isn't necessary as this one can be cleaned easily with liquid soap under the tap (fawcet?)(yes, I'm english). So I bought this model (8423A) and it arrived today..... Ok you want to know what it's like, so I'll tell you,,,,

- It looks great!
- It charged in about 40 mins
- It shaved off 3 days of beard in about 7 mins (I was being careful bearing in mind its a new type of shaver on my skin).
- It's shaved me SO close that I'm absolutely Amazed.
- I have no irritation (the foils just don't seem to pick up my skin at all).
- I used it dry - can't wait to try it in the shower.
- It did miss a few particularly flat hairs on my neck, but I was able to get them with the trimmer and then shave over.
- I had a go at the cleaning routine - it's not difficult.

Technology continues to march on!

Whether you go for this one, or the cleaning station version, I'm sure that you will be delighted. This shaver is FANTASTIC!

It definitely works for different skin types. I would repurchase.

I applied it on it's own and I could barely tell the smell. First it definitely smelled like a rubbing alcohol... but after few seconds I could tell a scent of luxurience and opulence. But after an hour I couldn't tell if scent was there or not... So I went to work today and mixed it with CK Be. one spray of CK Be and two sprays of Molecule... I kept getting compliments, so much that it became annoying. I got too many compliments and extraneous attention. Women were just keep leaning towards me to smell me, and about 50-60 compliments. And guys were looking at me, it's a look of being inspired.

Every 2-3 minutes I have a new rich customer at our luxury store. That's why I was over-exposed to too many people and got more than enough attention on a mixture of cologne that never got compliments prior to this when I wore it, but I like the scent of CK be so I mixed it with molecule 01. The scent also lasted longer. I'm not sure whether this is a placebo effect, but it did seem like CK be lasted for at least twice longer. I could feel everybody liked the way I smelled today. I'm not even exaggerating, I felt like a celebrity...

It's hard to explain what it smells like. On youtube they describe the smell but it's either confusing or inaccurate.. It smells pleasant, that's all I can say. As if you're not using a cologne yet you emit vibes that you're rich.

I'll try to wear it by itself tomorrow, to see if it works on it's own. Instructions say to be patient with it, don't just throw in a towel just because you can't smell enough of it.. That's what I'm trying to do... Definitely will order Molecule 02 and if it's good keep exploring everything this brand has to offer...

Updates pending.
