title: LONG THICK HAIR - BEST ROUND BRUSH EVER
text: I have very long and very thick hair ... I don't always have full use of my hands due to disability so this was taking a real chance - even before my disability I've always had hair down to almost my bottom ... and at the shortest, to the edges of my shoulder blades (middle of my back) ... THIS BRUSH did NOT tangle my hair - this brush actually went through my thick hair and gave it body and allowed me to flip at the ends and where I wanted .... for me to have some height and shape - takes a lot and can be painful for me ... until I got this brush I mostly let my hair air dry and let it go wavy ... then used a curling iron .. but I like to wear my hair straight - with some "sas" .... this brush helps me in that ... it does not tear up my scalp or hurt .... it does let me use it without causing pain to my disabled hands (nerve damage from neck) ... and being able to use the brush more easily than most, I can dry my hair all the way, leaving it to look shinny and healthy and I'm so glad.  I've NEVER had a round brush that has done this .. and at such an inexpensive price ... I've spent up to $70 on hair brushes in the past .... just to make my life easier ...(not recently but way back before I was disabled) ... None of the brushes worked as well as this and I could not recommend it well enough.  I was so surprised!  Also - With a recent really really really bad hair cut ... ugh ... .this brush made it so much easier to work with my hair ...  I'm grateful to have it.

title: The product works well.
text: This is starting to work.  I was going to give this four stars because of the small bottle, a few ounces more would have been nice.  However, the dog's teeth are so much better.  He had a lot of dark grey on some of his large back teeth, and with this product they went to light grey and now there is just a touch of grey on his teeth near the gum line and his front teeth are bright white from being slightly yellow.  This happened within a few days of using the produc Plaque Blastt, as I just started to use it a few days ago.  My dog is an adult 2.5 year rescue dog Shar pei mix and he was making sounds with his mouth before using this product, especially during the evenings as though his teeth and/or gums bothered him.  The general Vet had said he has gingivitis and another at another Vet place a vet technician said he had plaque--that was  before using this product.  Before going to a dentist, I wanted some relief for him.  At first, he did not like the Plaque Blast spray and would not let me use it on his teeth, so I used another dog teeth cleaner that was a gel and used gauze to brush that on.  After doing that for several days and unsure of the result, as the results were not very noticeable, I was fortunately easily able to use this Plaque Blast product as he became used to me putting a cleaner on his teeth.  I then switched totally to  Plaque Blast from the different gel product of another company because it contained  ingredients that could be iffy for a dog.  The Plaque Blast seems to have less harmful ingredients for a dog.  He likes the taste.  He does not make funny sounds with his mouth in the evenings anymore either.  I will continue to use this to help keep his teeth clean.  I still have to go to a dog dentist because I am unsure if he has gingivitis still and if this product works for that (though his gums look a healthier pink color since using Plaque Blast, and to see if he has cavities as I am unsure if he has ever been to a dog dentist).  His teeth are definitely cleaner that from when I got him several months ago, thanks to Plaque Blast.

While I did enjoy the overall creaminess of this particular night cream and I definitely appreciated the fact that I didn’t have to use a lot to achieve maximum coverage, (a pea-sized amount on my fingertip did the trick.) I found the smell of this product to be a little heavier and lingering than you might expect of a product meant to be used before bed, but that I could bypass… what I couldn’t however, was that next day feeling.

Instead of waking up and feeling as if my skin were properly hydrated and moisturized, I found that the overall texture had become noticeably dryer than before I began to incorporate this product into my nighttime routine and that throughout several weeks I found myself having to apply creams and lotions throughout the day to help get my skin’s texture back to its natural state, which is why I can only give this one star.

⭐️

While it’s true that everyone experiences different results, if your skin tends to dry out easily, I’d recommend using extreme care when trying out this particular brand of night cream.

title: It's FAB! Just love yourself and click the 'Buy Now'
text:
This is my second purchase of this unit, this time for the shorter length. The first is still lovely and in great shape after two months of pretty frequent wear.
It's easy to care for, easy to pluck & color the part, and with a quick application of the blow dryer I was able to modify the front/bangs portion to my face. (note: this is NOT a lace front wig but the front styling is well-done and simple to adjust).
The hair is thick (could certainly be plucked if you're looking for a lighter wear) and doesn't show the synthetic shine of more expensive units, imo. Color is rich and the ombre/darker roost effect looks natural even in sunlight.
Because it's not a lace front, I wish the center front had a comb or clip, but this doesn't detract from the unit overall.
Best wig purchase I've made in a long time (enough to buy twice), and for the price it's an absolute steal! Put it in the cart <3

title: I love snails!
text:
I love snail slime. I have been reading about it for a while and am so glad I pulled the trigger to purchase it. I get occasional acne and scar easily. After two uses I saw a profound improvement in my skin. Nothing works that fast.I am a believer and am buying up all the slime I can find. The use of snail slime to improve skin dates back to ancient Greece, where Hippocrates, the famous physician, reportedly prescribed crushed snails and sour milk as a way to rid the skin of inflammation. In more recent times, the use of snail creams started when Chilean farmers who handled snails for the French market noticed their skin was visibly smoother. Nowadays, it is the secreted slime discovered by these farmers that is harvested to produce snail cream, not crushed up snails.
How the Slime Works
When snails are agitated, they excrete a thick fluid as a means to protect themselves. It may sound odd to use something like that on your skin, but remember that humans and most other animals also excrete oils as a way to protect their skin. In fact, the oil your body excretes to moisturize your skin is made up of lipids, sebum oil, and dead skin cells. As a snail protects itself, the slime that is excreted from its body is packed with nutrients like hyaluronic acid, glycoprotein enzymes, antimicrobial and copper peptides, and proteoglycans. All of these nutrients are already commonly added to beauty products and are thought to provide many benefits to skin.
The science behind snail slime as a viable beauty cream is mostly derived from lab studies where the effects of the slime have been tested on a variety of cell cultures. In these studies, research suggests that snail slime will stimulate the production of elastin and collagen, increase fibronectin protein production, and stimulate increased proliferation of fibroblasts. While all of these traits could be beneficial for skin, there have yet to be significant cosmetic trials or research into how snail slime actually affects the skin, and how long those effects last. In fact, there haven’t been any significant clinical trials on how a specific beauty product containing snail slime actually works on this skin – just the slime itself.
One of the main difficulties in conducting clinical trials on the benefits of snail slime is that the market has not fully figured out how to guarantee the results of testing. After all, if snail creams are to be effective, then the slime has to have a consistent concentration of the various chemical compounds, but this is difficult to guarantee. Because the success of trials leans heavily on the quality of snail extract used, the concentration of slime and the way it is excreted and processed, test results can sometimes be misleading. Some companies that manufacture snail creams do choose to keep a steady supply of their own snails so they can better regulate the extraction and formulation of the slime.

title: Primal Elements Sampler Soap Grab bag...A wonderful surprise awaits.
text: I used to buy this soap by the individual bar at what I consider to be a premium price and would have to really guess if it would be an ideal scent or something I was disappointed with.  Let me tell you, they are not only beautiful and whimsical, the scents seem to go with the pics on the bar of soap.  Since they are made in long loaf type cylinders (or something like it), they cut the loafs of soaps in to bars and ship them out.  The trouble is they have so many different ones and different scents that I got tired of guessing and then discovered that they offer what they call a grab bag of different soaps that are about 3/4 of an inch thick up to about 1 inch thick.  I absolutely enjoy each sample bag I have gotten and they haven't repeated a scent yet.  They are a much better value when you buy the grab bag  and even if you don't like 1 or 2 of the scents, you can give them away as a gift on their own to someone else.  It's still got many scents to enjoy in the remaining soaps.  I was going to give this as a gift each time but I kept it for myself and bought them a different gift.  They are that good.  You should try this product.  I wasn't disappointed and I don't think you will be either.

The purple color is also fun and helps keep the product attractive to the kids.

title: BEST BREAST FEEDING PRODUCT
text:
Short review: very versatile (I use on my baby's delicate skin and my chapped lips), rehydrates skin instantly, all natural ingredients.

Long Review:
First time mom here,

I absolutely love, love, love this salve! Every woman I spoke to about breast feeding in my family recommended lanolin cream but I knew I wanted to look for a natural alternative. I came across this company on instagram and decided to try them out as they were the least expensive of some of the other competitors. I have a flat nipple so the beginning of breast feeding was very uncomfortable. I made sure to apply the salve after each feeding and it surely works wonders. My nipples would be cracked and dry after feedings but after I put this on it instantly healed them. I love that I don't have to wipe it off before feedings. This salve is so versatile, I use it on my baby when she scratches herself and on her skin when it peels, I even use it on my lips as chapstick! This is honestly the best investment I've made for myself as a new mom!

title: Not for sensitive skin!
text:
I ordered this eye serum to add on to my skincare routine. I am 26, and my skin is reaching the point where it no longer "bounces back" quite like it used to! My current routine is fairly simple - cleanse with Cetaphil and moisturize with the standard Olay moisturizer. I also use a mild retinol product every other night.

I first used this eye serum in the evening after cleansing, but before moisturizing. Unfortunately, my first impression of the product was a burning/stinging sensation. It subsided after a minute after I moisturized, and did not leave any residual redness. I chalked it up to my skin acclimating to a new product. I skipped retinol the next evening and tried it again two days after my first attempt. Same results. After a third round of skipping retinol (and waiting 3 days) and trying again with the same stinging result, I decided that this product simply does not work with my skin. For the most part, I do not have any issues with skin sensitivity, so I'm not sure what was going on with this product. I wish that I could have used it for a longer period of time to see how effective it was, but it was too uncomfortable.

I received this product at a discount in exchange for my honest and unbiased opinion, which I have provided above.
